sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“罪案档案：现场呈现”的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: At 2pm on Monday, August 22, 2005, 38-year-old Stacey Castor called the police.
sentences.zh: 2005年8月22日，星期一，下午2点，38岁的史黛西·卡斯特报警了。

sentences.en: She was the office manager at her husband David's heating and air conditioning business, and he hadn't shown up for work that day.
sentences.zh: 她是她丈夫大卫的冷暖气设备公司的办公室经理，而大卫那天没有去上班。

sentences.en: Stacey was concerned because David had been acting erratically lately.
sentences.zh: 史黛西很担心，因为大卫最近表现得很异常。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the couple had an argument that culminated in David yelling at Stacey to take the kids and get out.
sentences.zh: 周末的时候，夫妻俩大吵了一架，最后大卫大吼着让史黛西带着孩子滚出去。

sentences.en: He also warned her that if she ever left him, he would make her sorry.
sentences.zh: 他还警告她，如果她敢离开他，他会让她后悔的。

sentences.en: Afterward, he locked himself in the bedroom of their home in the town of Clay, New York.
sentences.zh: 随后，他把自己反锁在位于纽约州克莱镇家中的卧室里。

sentences.en: Stacey hadn't heard from David since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，史黛西就再也没有大卫的消息了。

sentences.en: She tried calling him at home, but he didn't answer.
sentences.zh: 她试过给家里的他打电话，但没有人接。

sentences.en: She told the police she couldn't understand why he was acting this way, but admitted that he had been depressed lately.
sentences.zh: 她告诉警方，她不明白他为什么会这样，但她承认他最近情绪低落。

sentences.en: She agreed to meet an officer at the house so they could conduct a welfare check.
sentences.zh: 她同意在房子里与警官会合，以便他们进行安全探视。

sentences.en: Sergeant Robert Willoughby arrived at the Castor's home and found Stacey sitting in a lawn chair out the front.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·威洛比警长抵达卡斯特家，发现史黛西正坐在前院的草坪椅上。

sentences.en: Given the situation, her body language was unusually relaxed.
sentences.zh: 鉴于当时的情况，她的肢体语言异常放松。

sentences.en: She explained that she'd been waiting for the police to arrive before she entered the house.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，她一直在等警察到来才敢进屋。

sentences.en: Stacey let Sergeant Willoughby inside, stopping in the kitchen while he continued toward the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 史黛西让威洛比警长进了屋，在厨房停了下来，而警长则继续走向主卧室。

sentences.en: He found it unusual that she showed little interest in checking on her husband herself.
sentences.zh: 他觉得奇怪的是，她对亲自查看丈夫的情况似乎没什么兴趣。

sentences.en: Willoughby tried the bedroom door and found it locked.
sentences.zh: 威洛比试着拉了拉卧室门，发现门锁着。

sentences.en: He knocked loudly and identified himself, but received no response.
sentences.zh: 他大声敲门并表明了身份，但没有得到任何回应。

sentences.en: Unsure whether David was inside, Willoughby walked around the outside of the house to see if he could look into the room through a window.
sentences.zh: 不确定大卫是否在里面，威洛比绕到房子外面，想看看能不能透过窗户往屋里看。

sentences.en: The blinds were closed, so he retrieved a ladder to check a higher window, but still couldn't get a clear view.
sentences.zh: 百叶窗拉着，于是他拿来一把梯子去查看较高的一扇窗户，但依然无法看清里面。

sentences.en: Sergeant Willoughby went back inside.
sentences.zh: 威洛比警长回到了屋内。

sentences.en: Stacey followed him for a moment before inexplicably disappearing into the garage.
sentences.zh: 史黛西跟着他走了一会儿，随后莫名其妙地消失在了车库里。

sentences.en: With no other option, Willoughby kicked open the bedroom door.
sentences.zh: 别无选择，威洛比一脚踹开了卧室的门。

sentences.en: Inside, he found 48-year-old David Castor lying naked on the bed.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他发现48岁的大卫·卡斯特赤身裸体地躺在床上。

sentences.en: He was motionless, turned on his side and facing the wall.
sentences.zh: 他一动不动，侧身躺着，面向墙壁。

sentences.en: What appeared to be reddish-brown vomit had pulled around his head and was caked on his hands.
sentences.zh: 一滩貌似红褐色的呕吐物聚集在他的头部周围，并且凝结在他的手上。

sentences.en: Clothes and bedding scattered messily throughout the room also appeared to be stained with vomit.
sentences.zh: 房间里凌乱散落的衣物和床品似乎也沾上了呕吐物。

sentences.en: One of David's hands was stiff and curled in a claw-like position, as though he had been gripping a glass.
sentences.zh: 大卫的一只手僵硬地蜷缩成爪状，仿佛他刚才一直握着一个杯子。

sentences.en: On the nightstand beside the bed were remnants of cranberry juice, a bottle of apricot brandy and a short glass half-filled with a bright green liquid.
sentences.zh: 床头柜上放着蔓越莓汁的残渣、一瓶杏仁白兰地和一个半满的、装着鲜绿色液体的矮玻璃杯。

sentences.en: From outside the room, Stacey called out, asking whether her husband was okay.
sentences.zh: 史黛西在房间外喊着，问她的丈夫没事吧。

sentences.en: Willoughby checked David's pulse before responding.
sentences.zh: 威洛比检查了大卫的脉搏，然后才回答。

sentences.en: No, he's not.
sentences.zh: 不，他不在了。

sentences.en: Stacey Castor appeared at the bedroom door, saw her husband on the bed, and screamed.
sentences.zh: 史黛西·卡斯特出现在卧室门口，看到床上的丈夫，尖叫起来。

sentences.en: She started yelling hysterically, bring him back, bring him back, he's not dead, he's not dead.
sentences.zh: 她歇斯底里地大喊，救救他，救救他，他没死，他没死。

sentences.en: A forensic examiner who soon arrived at the scene concluded that David Castor had only been deceased for a short time.
sentences.zh: 不久后赶到现场的法医鉴定认为，大卫·卡斯特去世时间不长。

sentences.en: Mucus dripping from his mouth and nose suggested that he had died.
sentences.zh: 从他口鼻中流出的黏液表明他已经死亡。

sentences.en: It didn't smell like liquor, but appeared to be antifreeze, a liquid used in vehicle cooling systems to regulate engine temperature.
sentences.zh: 它没有酒味，但看起来像是防冻液，一种用于汽车冷却系统以调节发动机温度的液体。

sentences.en: A blue plastic bottle of Peek brand antifreeze was discovered on the bedroom floor, partially tucked under the bed frame directly underneath David's overhanging feet.
sentences.zh: 卧室地板上发现了一个蓝色的Peek牌防冻液塑料瓶，它部分塞在床架下，正对着大卫垂在床沿外的双脚下方。

sentences.en: It appeared that he had consumed the poisonous antifreeze and taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 看起来他喝下了有毒的防冻液并了结了自己的生命。

sentences.en: But something was off about the scene.
sentences.zh: 但现场有些不对劲。

sentences.en: On the side of the bed closest to the door, a trail of vomit ran down the bare mattress and pooled on the rug below.
sentences.zh: 在靠近门的那侧床沿，有一道呕吐物的痕迹顺着光床垫流下，在下方的地毯上聚成一滩。

sentences.en: The bottle of antifreeze was positioned on its side on top of the pooled vomit, but the container itself was notably clean.
sentences.zh: 防冻液瓶侧倒在呕吐物滩的顶部，但容器本身却异常干净。

sentences.en: It appeared as though the bottle had been placed there after David vomited.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就像是在大卫呕吐之后，这个瓶子才被放在那里的。

sentences.en: Even the glass of antifreeze on the nightstand looked remarkably clean, given David's state and the room in general.
sentences.zh: 考虑到大卫的状态和整个房间的情况，床头柜上的防冻液杯子也显得异常干净。

sentences.en: A loaded shotgun was also found under the bed.
sentences.zh: 床底下还发现了一把装了子弹的猎枪。

sentences.en: Stacey hadn't mentioned it, so the police were surprised to find it.
sentences.zh: 史黛西并没有提过此事，因此警方对发现这把枪感到很意外。

sentences.en: In the adjacent bathroom, a towel rack had been torn from the wall, but nothing else appeared amiss in the rest of the house.
sentences.zh: 在隔壁的浴室里，毛巾架被从墙上扯了下来，但房子其余地方看起来一切正常。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Stacey remained in a state of denial about her husband's death, demanding that paramedics come to the house and save him.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，史黛西对丈夫的死仍然处于否认状态，要求急救人员来家里救救他。

sentences.en: When questioned at the scene, she revealed that David had been drinking copious amounts of alcohol that weekend and had not been acting like himself.
sentences.zh: 在现场接受盘问时，她透露大卫那个周末一直在大量饮酒，行为举止很不正常。

sentences.en: Stacey said she hadn't been at home the day before as she'd been out shopping.
sentences.zh: 史黛西说她前一天不在家，因为她出去购物了。

sentences.en: She said she'd gone to Walmart and had a receipt to prove it, but couldn't remember what she had done with it and that she must have thrown it away.
sentences.zh: 她说她去了沃尔玛，还有收据可以证明，但记不清把收据放哪了，肯定是被她当垃圾扔了。

sentences.en: Police searched the kitchen bin in an attempt to find the receipt.
sentences.zh: 警方搜查了厨房的垃圾桶，试图找到那张收据。

sentences.en: Barely hidden beneath a few pieces of paper, they discovered a turkey bay star.
sentences.zh: 在几张纸的掩盖下，他们发现了一个火鸡吸管（注：此处原文turkey bay star应为turkey baster火鸡滴管之误，但根据上下文译为火鸡滴管）。

sentences.en: It appeared to be brand new and contained a few small drops of green liquid, confirmed to be antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像是全新的，里面有几滴绿色的液体，经证实是防冻液。

sentences.en: Stacey Castor went on to provide an eight-page statement detailing the lead-up to her husband's death.
sentences.zh: 史黛西·卡斯特接着提供了一份八页的陈述，详述了她丈夫去世前的种种情况。

sentences.en: While she appeared shaken, her account was coherent, clear, and highly detailed, not something typically seen in newly widowed people experiencing shock.
sentences.zh: 虽然她看起来有些震惊，但她的叙述连贯、清晰且细节详尽，这并不是刚失去丈夫陷入震惊的人通常会有的表现。

sentences.en: Simply stating that she had gone to a fast food restaurant wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 仅仅说自己去了一家快餐店是不够的。

sentences.en: She described pulling into the drive-thru and listed every item she purchased, including the sizes.
sentences.zh: 她描述了开车去免下车餐厅的过程，并列出了她购买的每一件商品，包括尺寸。

sentences.en: She recalled the specific brand of cigarettes she bought at a convenience store, the people she spoke to on the phone, and the names of friends she ran into.
sentences.zh: 她记起了在便利店买的香烟的具体品牌、在电话里交谈的人，以及偶遇的朋友的名字。

sentences.en: Stacey repeatedly described David as being depressed, anxious, and stressed, something she said was exacerbated by the recent death of his father and business troubles.
sentences.zh: 史黛西反复描述大卫情绪低落、焦虑且压力巨大，她称这由于他父亲最近的去世以及商业上的困境而加剧。

sentences.en: Referring to David as melancholy by nature, she also claimed he was unhappy with himself and his perceived inadequacies, which led to low self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 她称大卫天生忧郁，还声称他对自己的现状以及自认为的不足之处感到不满，从而导致了低自尊。

sentences.en: According to Stacey, David often lamented that he didn't have long to live.
sentences.zh: 据史黛西说，大卫经常哀叹自己时日无多。

sentences.en: He believed his blood pressure was dangerously high and that he could drop it dead any day.
sentences.zh: 他认为自己的血压高得危险，随时都可能突然死亡。

sentences.en: Although David often talked about what would happen if he were gone, asking Stacey what she would do and how she would survive, he didn't seem afraid of death itself.
sentences.zh: 尽管大卫经常谈论如果他不在了会怎么样，问史黛西她会怎么做、怎么活下去，但他似乎并不怕死本身。

sentences.en: What really frightened him was the prospect of a medical episode that would leave him incapacitated.
sentences.zh: 真正让他害怕的是可能会导致他失去行动能力的医疗突发状况。

sentences.en: He didn't want his family burdened with his long-term care or medical expenses.
sentences.zh: 他不想让家人背负他长期的护理费用或医疗开支。

sentences.en: While Stacey admitted that she and David were prone to arguments, she said they had become more frequent in the week before his death.
sentences.zh: 虽然史黛西承认她和大卫容易争吵，但她说在丈夫去世前的一周里，争吵变得更加频繁了。

sentences.en: Their second wedding anniversary passed without celebration and she described the relationship as having lost its spark.
sentences.zh: 他们的结婚两周年纪念日在没有庆祝中度过，她形容这段感情已经失去了火花。

sentences.en: Stacey even admitted that she had begun seeing another man.
sentences.zh: 史黛西甚至承认她已经开始和另一个男人交往。

sentences.en: For his part, David had tried to bring some romance back into the relationship by suggesting they go on a second honeymoon, but Stacey didn't think it was practical.
sentences.zh: 就大卫而言，他曾建议去度第二次蜜月，以此来为这段感情找回一些浪漫，但史黛西觉得这不切实际。

sentences.en: She felt they would have to take their daughters with them as the youngest was 15 and Stacey thought she was still too young to stay home alone for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他们得带着女儿们一起去，因为小女儿15岁了，史黛西认为她年纪还小，不能独自在家待两个星期。

sentences.en: This led to their biggest argument yet.
sentences.zh: 这引发了他们最大的一次争吵。

sentences.en: David had always carried some resentment about being a stepfather to Stacey's two girls and he often expressed jealousy when she gave them attention instead of him.
sentences.zh: 大卫对于给史黛西的两个女孩当继父一直心存怨恨，当史黛西把注意力放在她们身上而不是他身上时，他常常表现出嫉妒。

sentences.en: It was this latest fight that led to David locking himself in the bedroom on the night of Friday,
sentences.zh: 正是最近的这场争吵导致大卫在星期五的晚上把自己反锁在卧室里，

sentences.en: August 19.
sentences.zh: 也就是8月19日。

sentences.en: When he eventually emerged, he and Stacey spent the next seven hours arguing on and off about their many issues.
sentences.zh: 当他最终出来时，他和史黛西断断续续地花了整整七个小时争论他们的种种问题。

sentences.en: Stacey recalled David drinking a glass of soda during the ordeal.
sentences.zh: 史黛西回忆说，在经历这场折磨时，大卫喝了一杯苏打水。

sentences.en: When she asked for a sip, he told her, get your own.
sentences.zh: 当她要求喝一口时，他对她说，自己去倒。

sentences.en: She thought he was simply being difficult, but in hindsight, she wondered whether he had put something in the drink to harm himself and didn't want her to be affected as well.
sentences.zh: 她以为他只是在故意找茬，但事后回想起来，她怀疑他是否在饮料里下了药来伤害自己，又不想让她也受到波及。

sentences.en: While David had never been violent towards Stacey, she said that the recent change in his demeanour
sentences.zh: 虽然大卫从未对史黛西施暴，但她说他最近神态的变化

sentences.en: made her feel as though he could lash out at any moment and she became afraid to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 让她觉得他随时可能爆发，她开始害怕跟他说话。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, David continued to isolate himself in the bedroom and to drink heavily, at times vomiting all over himself.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，大卫继续把自己关在卧室里，借酒浇愁，有时甚至吐了一身。

sentences.en: Stacey said she tried to help by cleaning up, keeping David hydrated and rubbing his sore feet.
sentences.zh: 史黛西说她试图帮忙收拾残局、给大卫补充水分并揉捏他酸痛的脚来提供帮助。

sentences.en: As his condition worsened, she repeatedly asked whether he needed medical attention, but David refused.
sentences.zh: 随着他的病情恶化，她多次询问他是否需要就医，但大卫拒绝了。

sentences.en: On Saturday, David passed out on the bedroom floor and Stacey had to call a friend to help lift him onto the bed.
sentences.zh: 周六，大卫昏倒在卧室地板上，史黛西不得不叫了一个朋友来帮忙把他抬到床上。

sentences.en: The friend verified this account, stating that David was completely out of it and didn't even recognise him despite having known him for years.
sentences.zh: 这位朋友证实了这种说法，称大卫当时完全不省人事，甚至连认识多年的他都认不出来了。

sentences.en: Stacey was in and out of the house throughout the day, but said she checked in on David whenever she was home.
sentences.zh: 史黛西这一天进进出出，但她说只要在家就会去看看大卫的情况。

sentences.en: She also claimed she called him regularly while she was out.
sentences.zh: 她还声称自己外出时经常给他打电话。

sentences.en: At 5am on Sunday, August 21, Stacey said she heard David dry retching in the bedroom and went in to make sure he was okay.
sentences.zh: 8月21日星期日上午5点，史黛西说她听到大卫在卧室里干呕，便进去查看他是否安好。

sentences.en: She found him naked and convulsing.
sentences.zh: 她发现他赤身裸体且在抽搐。

sentences.en: He yelled at her to leave him alone and to get the fuck out of the house, ordering her to take her children with her.
sentences.zh: 他冲她大吼，让她别管他，马上滚出房子，命令她把孩子也带走。

sentences.en: Stacey shut the door and left the house with her daughters, fearing what David might do if she didn't.
sentences.zh: 史黛西关上门，带着女儿们离开了家，生怕大卫不高兴会做出什么事来。

sentences.en: It was the last time she saw him alive.
sentences.zh: 那是她最后一次见到活生生的大卫。

sentences.en: To Stacey, it seemed that David wasn't going to stop until he had drunk himself to death.
sentences.zh: 对史黛西来说，大卫似乎不喝到酒精中毒死亡是不会罢休的。

sentences.en: At 7.30 on the morning of Monday, August 22, she went to their shared workplace alone.
sentences.zh: 8月22日星期一早上7点半，她独自去了他们共同的工作场所。

sentences.en: She gave David time to sort himself out, but as the day wore on and he failed to appear, she began to have a bad feeling.
sentences.zh: 她给大卫时间让他自己冷静下来，但随着时间推移，他迟迟没有露面，她开始有一种不祥的预感。

sentences.en: When she was unable to reach him, that's when she decided to call the police.
sentences.zh: 当她无法联系到他时，她便决定报警。

sentences.en: The Castor family's relatives and friends painted a very different picture of David and
sentences.zh: 卡斯特一家的亲朋好友对大卫和

sentences.en: Stacey's marriage.
sentences.zh: 史黛西的婚姻有着截然不同的看法。

sentences.en: When the couple had tied the knot two years earlier, things had reportedly started well, with David described as treating Stacey like a princess.
sentences.zh: 据报道，两年前两人结婚时，一切似乎有个美好的开端，大卫被形容为把史黛西当成公主对待。

sentences.en: Aware that people could behave very differently in public than behind closed doors, investigators started looking into David's background for any red flags.
sentences.zh: 由于意识到人们在公众场合和私下里的表现可能大相径庭，调查人员开始调查大卫的背景，寻找任何危险信号。

sentences.en: There wasn't anything particularly unusual about him.
sentences.zh: 他没有什么特别异常的地方。

sentences.en: David had lived in the general area all his life and knew a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 大卫一生都住在当地，认识许多人。

sentences.en: He was an avid outdoorsman with lots of hobbies.
sentences.zh: 他是一个狂热的户外运动爱好者，有着许多爱好。

sentences.en: He particularly enjoyed snowmobiles and motorcycles, interests that Stacey outwardly supported, riding with him as his passenger.
sentences.zh: 他尤其喜欢雪地摩托和摩托车，史黛西表面上也很支持这些兴趣，经常坐在他身后当乘客。

sentences.en: As time went on, cracks in David and Stacey's marriage began to show.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，大卫和史黛西婚姻中的裂痕开始显现。

sentences.en: Most of their issues revolved around Stacey's two teenage daughters, Ashley and Bree, who didn't get along with David.
sentences.zh: 他们的大多数问题都围绕着史黛西的两个十几岁的女儿阿什利和布里，她们跟大卫合不来。

sentences.en: Stacey described her husband as having a king of the castle attitude towards her girls.
sentences.zh: 史黛西形容她的丈夫对她的女儿们有一种“唯我独尊”的态度。

sentences.en: They saw him as dictatorial and resented his lack of patience and his my-way-or-the-highway approach.
sentences.zh: 她们觉得他专断独行，并对他的缺乏耐心和“不听我的就走人”的作风感到不满。

sentences.en: Stacey tried to warn David that the girls wouldn't obey him without question, but he didn't listen.
sentences.zh: 史黛西试图警告大卫，女孩们不会无条件服从他，但他根本听不进去。

sentences.en: Conflicts and arguments were frequent, especially between David and Ashley, who was more upfront about her feelings.
sentences.zh: 冲突和争吵屡见不鲜，尤其是大卫和性格更直爽的阿什利之间。

sentences.en: David told others that Ashley was selfish and disrespectful.
sentences.zh: 大卫对别人说阿什利自私且不尊重人。

sentences.en: Ashley openly admitted that she didn't get along with David.
sentences.zh: 阿什利公开承认她和大小合不来。

sentences.en: He constantly alternated between wanting to be a father figure to her and her sister and not wanting anything to do with them.
sentences.zh: 他总是在想成为她和她姐姐的父亲形象，以及不想跟她们有任何瓜葛之间反复横跳。

sentences.en: Ashley and Bree missed their lives with their mother before David came into the picture and resented that he took up most of her time.
sentences.zh: 阿什利和布里怀念在大卫出现之前与母亲相依为命的生活，并怨恨他占用了母亲的大部分时间。

sentences.en: They had overheard the fiery arguments between the two which usually took place in the garage in an attempt to keep the girls out of it.
sentences.zh: 她们无意中听到过两人之间的激烈争吵，这些争吵通常发生在车库里，目的是为了不让女孩们听到。

sentences.en: Ashley told the police that she didn't see David at all on the weekend before his death,
sentences.zh: 阿什利告诉警方，在大卫去世前的周末她根本没见到大卫，

sentences.en: while Bree admitted to opening his bedroom door and seeing him on the floor in his underwear.
sentences.zh: 而布里则承认她曾推开大卫的卧室门，看到他穿着内衣躺在地板上。

sentences.en: Regardless of their family issues, the girls were shocked and upset to learn that David had taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 抛开家庭矛盾不谈，女孩们得知大卫自杀的消息后感到震惊和难过。

sentences.en: They'd been completely unaware that he was depressed, yet their mother assured them that he was.
sentences.zh: 她们完全不知道他情绪低落，然而她们的母亲却向她们保证说他确实如此。

sentences.en: David Castor's autopsy revealed the presence of microscopic crystals in his kidneys, which confirmed he had consumed a fatal amount of antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡斯特的尸检在其肾脏中发现了微小晶体，这证实他摄入了致死量的防冻液。

sentences.en: Antifreeze poisoning results in a gradual build-up of symptoms, starting with slurred speech, confusion, poor coordination, nausea and drowsiness.
sentences.zh: 防冻液中毒会导致症状逐渐累积，最初表现为言语不清、神志不清、协调能力差、恶心和嗜睡。

sentences.en: As the substance is metabolised, it breaks down into highly toxic acids that rapidly attack the
sentences.zh: 随着物质在体内代谢，它会分解成剧毒酸类，迅速侵袭

sentences.en: body, leading to severe metabolic acidosis, dehydration, abdominal and back pain and increasing neurological decline.
sentences.zh: 身体，导致严重的代谢性酸中毒、脱水、腹痛、背痛以及神经功能不断退化。

sentences.en: The most serious damage typically emerges in the kidneys, where crystal formation can cause
sentences.zh: 最严重的损害通常出现在肾脏，晶体形成会导致

sentences.en: acute renal failure, dramatically reducing urine output and triggering further systemic collapse.
sentences.zh: 急性肾衰竭，急剧减少尿量并引发进一步的系统性衰竭。

sentences.en: In its final stages, untreated poisoning can progress to heart rhythm disturbances, seizures, coma and ultimately death from multi-organ failure.
sentences.zh: 在晚期阶段，未经治疗的中毒可能会发展为心律失常、癫痫发作、昏迷，最终因多器官衰竭而死亡。

sentences.en: It was a horrific way to die, but Stacey Castor didn't find it particularly unusual that David had chosen this method to take his own life.
sentences.zh: 这是一种极其痛苦的死法，但史黛西·卡斯特并不觉得大卫选择这种方式了结生命有什么特别不寻常的地方。

sentences.en: She said they had recently watched an episode of the true crime series, 48 Hours, in which a woman killed her two husbands by spiking their food with antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 她说他们最近看过一集真实犯罪剧集《48小时》，其中一个女人在食物里下防冻液谋杀了她的两任丈夫。

sentences.en: She and David had seen the episode twice.
sentences.zh: 她和大卫把那一集看过两遍。

sentences.en: Given the context, this admission stood out to investigators, but the medical examiner didn't find any signs of foul play and concluded that David had indeed died by suicide.
sentences.zh: 结合上下文，这一供述引起了调查人员的注意，但法医没有发现任何谋杀的迹象，并断定大卫确实是自杀身亡。

sentences.en: David's loved ones weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 大卫的至亲并不买账。

sentences.en: Given that David worked in the heating and cooling industry and spent a lot of time around cars and motorcycles, he was fully aware of what antifreeze could do.
sentences.zh: 鉴于大卫从事冷暖气行业，且经常接触汽车和摩托车，他完全清楚防冻液能造成什么后果。

sentences.en: His loved ones didn't believe he would willingly subject himself to such a painful death, and they viewed the entire suicide theory as preposterous.
sentences.zh: 他的至亲不相信他会自愿承受如此痛苦的死法，他们认为所谓的自杀理论荒谬绝伦。

sentences.en: As far as they were concerned, David was a happy man, living a life he enjoyed, and was far from depressed, let alone suicidal.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，大卫是一个快乐的人，过着他喜欢的生活，远谈不上抑郁，更别提自杀了。

sentences.en: Even if he was, they questioned why he would choose a slow, torturous death when a loaded shotgun was readily available beneath his bed.
sentences.zh: 退一步讲，如果他真的抑郁了，他们不明白为什么床底下明明有一把装了子弹的猎枪，他却偏偏要选择一种缓慢而折磨人的死法。

sentences.en: They also took issue with the way Stacey portrayed David as an alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 他们对史黛西将大卫描绘成一个酒鬼的说法也提出了异议。

sentences.en: According to those who knew him well, he wasn't a regular drinker and only consumed alcohol on special occasions.
sentences.zh: 据熟悉他的人说，他并不是个经常喝酒的人，只有在特殊场合才会饮酒。

sentences.en: From the outset, suspicions lingered that there was more to the story.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，人们就怀疑事情另有隐情。

sentences.en: Not only did the antifreeze bottle and glass in David's bedroom appear unusually clean, almost
sentences.zh: 不仅大卫卧室里的防冻液瓶和杯子显得异常干净，几乎

sentences.en: like they'd been staged, there was also the question of why a turkey baster containing antifreeze was found in the kitchen bin.
sentences.zh: 像是摆拍出来的，而且厨房垃圾桶里为什么会有一个装着防冻液的火鸡滴管也是个问题。

sentences.en: And why did Stacey call for a welfare check from her office instead of going to the house to check on David first?
sentences.zh: 为什么史黛西是从办公室打电话要求进行安全探视，而不是先去家里查看大卫的情况？

sentences.en: Investigators were convinced they were dealing with a murder.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确信他们面对的是一桩谋杀案。

sentences.en: They presented their suspicions to the medical examiner.
sentences.zh: 他们将自己的怀疑呈报给了法医。

sentences.en: While he wasn't convinced enough to change David's cause of death to homicide, he did think there were sufficient grounds to amend it to inconclusive.
sentences.zh: 虽然法医没有确信到将大卫的死因更改为何杰，但他确实认为有充分的理由将其修改为未明。

sentences.en: This opened up further investigative opportunities for police, and evidence taken from the Castor home was promptly sent for testing.
sentences.zh: 这为警方提供了进一步的调查契机，从卡斯特家中提取的证据被迅速送往检测。

sentences.en: A sample of David's blood returned surprising results.
sentences.zh: 大卫的血液样本检测出了令人惊讶的结果。

sentences.en: At the time of his death, he had very little alcohol in his bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 在他去世时，他血液中的酒精含量非常低。

sentences.en: Samples of his vomit also indicated that he had been sick shortly before his death, rather than continuously vomiting over a two-day period.
sentences.zh: 他的呕吐物样本也表明，他在死前不久曾感到不适，而不是在两天时间内持续呕吐。

sentences.en: These results contradicted Stacey's account of the weekend, in which she described David as consistently binge-drinking and repeatedly vomiting.
sentences.zh: 这些结果与斯泰西对那个周末的描述相矛盾，她称大卫一直在暴饮暴食并反复呕吐。

sentences.en: Fingerprints were lifted from the glass containing the antifreeze that David had allegedly drunk from, and an examination revealed they belonged to Stacey.
sentences.zh: 从装有大卫据称喝下的防冻液的玻璃杯上提取到了指纹，经检验发现属于斯泰西。

sentences.en: While there could be numerous innocent explanations for her fingerprints being on a drinking glass in
sentences.zh: 虽然她的指纹出现在一个

sentences.en: her own home, what struck detectives was that none of David's fingerprints were found on the glass.
sentences.zh: 自己家的水杯上可能有无数种无辜的解释，但让侦探们感到震惊的是，杯子上竟然没有大卫的任何指纹。

sentences.en: Nor were any discovered on the bottle of antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 防冻液瓶上也没有发现任何指纹。

sentences.en: A palm print was recovered from the bottle, but investigators were unable to conclusively determine who it belonged to.
sentences.zh: 瓶上提取到了一个掌纹，但调查人员无法确定它究竟属于谁。

sentences.en: Phone records revealed further holes in Stacey Castor's account.
sentences.zh: 通话记录显示斯泰西·卡斯特的陈述中存在更多漏洞。

sentences.en: While she had told police that she regularly called home over the weekend to check on David, records from her cell phone, work phone, and the various landlines she had access to
sentences.zh: 虽然她曾告诉警方，她在周末经常打电话回家查看大卫的情况，但根据她的手机、工作电话以及她可以使用的各种座机记录显示，

sentences.en: showed that she only called home once.
sentences.zh: 她整个周末只打过一次电话回家。

sentences.en: The call was made from her work phone on the afternoon of Monday August 22, right before she called 911.
sentences.zh: 这通电话是她在8月22日星期一的下午从工作电话打出的，就在她拨打911报警之前。

sentences.en: Investigators also found it odd that Stacey had arrived at work at 7.30am, but didn't call the police to conduct a welfare check until 2pm.
sentences.zh: 调查人员还觉得奇怪的是，斯泰西早上7点半就到了公司，直到下午2点才报警要求上门进行福利查访。

sentences.en: They wondered whether she was giving David ample time to die before notifying the authorities.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑她在通知当局之前，是否给了大卫充足的死亡时间。

sentences.en: The most compelling evidence came from the turkey baster found in the Castor family's kitchen bin.
sentences.zh: 最有力的证据来自卡斯特家族厨房垃圾桶里发现的火鸡滴油管。

sentences.en: David's DNA was found on the tip, in quantities far greater than would be expected from casual contact.
sentences.zh: 大卫的DNA在管尖上被发现，其数量远远超过日常接触所能产生的水平。

sentences.en: Testing showed the DNA was from his saliva, suggesting the tip of the baster had been in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 检测表明这些DNA来自他的唾液，这表明滴油管的尖端曾放进过他的口中。

sentences.en: The idea that David had administered antifreeze to himself in this way, especially if he had been as heavily intoxicated as Stacey claimed, seemed far-fetched to investigators.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，大卫以这种方式对自己使用防冻液的想法——尤其是如果他像斯泰西所说的那样喝得酩酊大醉的话——简直是天方夜谭。

sentences.en: They concluded that David was likely lying incapacitated on the bed while someone stood over him, using the baster to drip antifreeze into his mouth.
sentences.zh: 他们得出结论，大卫当时可能无力地躺在床上，而有人站在他身旁，用滴油管将防冻液滴入他的口中。

sentences.en: And while they believed that person was Stacey, they also explored other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们认为这个人就是斯泰西，但他们也探讨了其他可能性。

sentences.en: Investigators looked into whether David had any enemies, deaths, affairs, addictions, or a secret life that his friends and family might not know about.
sentences.zh: 调查人员调查了大卫是否有任何仇人、死亡事件、外遇、瘾头，或者朋友和家人可能不知道的秘密生活。

sentences.en: Finding no evidence that he did,
sentences.zh: 在没有发现任何此类证据的情况下，

sentences.en: Stacey Castor remained the primary suspect.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·卡斯特依然是头号嫌疑人。

sentences.en: This theory was bolstered by the discovery of David's will, in which he left Stacey his entire estate, including his business.
sentences.zh: 发现大卫的遗嘱后，这一推测得到了进一步加强。遗嘱中他将全部遗产，包括他的生意，都留给了斯泰西。

sentences.en: In the event that Stacey died before him, the will stipulated that David's estate would pass on to her two daughters, or their offspring.
sentences.zh: 如果在斯泰西比他先去世的情况下，遗嘱规定大卫的遗产将转交给她的两个女儿或其后代。

sentences.en: Notably, David's own son from a previous marriage was omitted from the will.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，大卫与前妻所生的亲生儿子并未被列入遗嘱。

sentences.en: This was perplexing, given that they had a good relationship, and in a previous will, David had left everything to his son and ex-wife.
sentences.zh: 这令人费解，鉴于他们关系很好，而且在之前的遗嘱中，大卫曾将一切留给他的儿子和前妻。

sentences.en: None of his family members were mentioned in the will either, which was highly unusual given how close he was to them.
sentences.zh: 遗嘱中也没有提及他的任何家庭成员，考虑到他与他们关系密切，这非常不寻常。

sentences.en: The will was apparently signed by David and two independent witnesses the day after he married Stacey.
sentences.zh: 这份遗嘱显然是在大卫与斯泰西结婚的第二天，由大卫和两位独立的证人签署的。

sentences.en: But David's signature appeared rough and uncertain, as though someone else was trying to replicate it.
sentences.zh: 但大卫的签名显得生硬而不确定，就好像是另一个人在试图模仿它一样。

sentences.en: Legally, the two witnesses were required to sign the document in David's presence.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，这两名证人必须在大卫在场的情况下签署该文件。

sentences.en: However, when questioned by investigators, they admitted that Stacey had brought them the document for the first time after David died and asked them to sign it.
sentences.zh: 然而，当面对调查人员的质问时，他们承认是大卫死后，斯泰西第一次把文件拿来让他们签字的。

sentences.en: Even though they knew it was wrong, they felt that Stacey had been through enough and they didn't think it would be a big deal.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们知道这样做不对，但他们觉得斯泰西已经经历够多苦难了，而且他们认为这不会是什么大事。

sentences.en: Neither of the witnesses said they had considered the possibility that Stacey could be using them as part of a larger scheme.
sentences.zh: 两位证人都表示，他们从未想过斯泰西会把他们当作更大阴谋的一部分来利用。

sentences.en: By the time of David's funeral, his loved ones were still confused about the circumstances of his death.
sentences.zh: 到了大卫的葬礼时，他的亲人们对他的死因仍然感到一头雾水。

sentences.en: To them, it all felt like a bad dream.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这一切就像是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: They couldn't reconcile what they had been told about David with what they personally knew about him.
sentences.zh: 他们无法将他们被告知的大卫形象与他们亲身了解的大卫结合起来。

sentences.en: Many were also left with an uneasy feeling about David's final resting place.
sentences.zh: 许多人对大卫最后的长眠之地也有一种不安的感觉。

sentences.en: Stacey had arranged to have him buried in a plot right next to a man named Michael Wallace, who happened to be her first husband.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西安排将他埋葬在一块墓地里，紧挨着一个名叫迈克尔·华莱士的男子，而此人恰好是她的第一任丈夫。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “案件档案”节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持“案件档案”继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: Michael Wallace was introduced to Stacey by Mutual Friends in 1985.
sentences.zh: 1985年，迈克尔·华莱士通过共同的朋友认识了斯泰西。

sentences.en: Stacey was in her senior year of high school and 24-year-old Michael was regarded as the life of the party.
sentences.zh: 当时斯泰西正读高中最后一年，24岁的迈克尔被视为派对上的灵魂人物。

sentences.en: She was immediately smitten and not at all concerned that Michael came with a history.
sentences.zh: 她立刻坠入爱河，完全不在乎迈克尔过去有过一段历史。

sentences.en: He had spent time in jail for driving while intoxicated, had several children from a previous marriage and was reportedly abusive to his ex-partner.
sentences.zh: 他曾因酒后驾车入狱，与前妻育有几个孩子，据报道还曾虐待过前伴侣。

sentences.en: While Stacey knew that Michael wasn't perfect, she viewed him as a big-hearted guy who would do anything for anybody.
sentences.zh: 虽然斯泰西知道迈克尔并不完美，但她认为他是一个热心肠的人，愿意为任何人做任何事。

sentences.en: Stacey said she knew she wanted a future with Michael within five minutes of meeting him.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西说，在见到迈克尔的五分钟内，她就知道自己想要和他有一个未来。

sentences.en: A whirlwind romance ensued and Stacey thought of Michael as the love of her life.
sentences.zh: 随后是一场旋风般的恋爱，斯泰西将迈克尔视为她一生的挚爱。

sentences.en: But when she became pregnant at 19,
sentences.zh: 但当她在19岁怀孕时，

sentences.en: Michael wasn't willing to commit.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔却不愿承担责任。

sentences.en: The pair separated before Stacey gave birth to their daughter, Ashley.
sentences.zh: 两人在斯泰西生下女儿阿什利之前就分居了。

sentences.en: Stacey focused her attention on her baby, feeling that her purpose was to take care of her.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西将注意力集中在孩子身上，觉得自己的使命就是照顾她。

sentences.en: In time, Michael and Stacey reconnected and, to Stacey's delight, he proposed.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，迈克尔和斯泰西重新联系上了，令斯泰西欣喜的是，他向她求婚了。

sentences.en: With their rocky start behind them, they became inseparable.
sentences.zh: 抛开坎坷的起步，他们变得密不可分。

sentences.en: Others recalled how joyful Stacey was at the time, saying that with Michael, she was the happiest she had ever been.
sentences.zh: 其他人回忆起当时斯泰西是多么快乐，并说有了迈克尔，她感到了前所未有的幸福。

sentences.en: She spoke about him as though he were a Hollywood movie star.
sentences.zh: 她谈起他时，就像他是好莱坞电影明星一样。

sentences.en: She didn't even mind Michael remaining close to his first wife and other children, inviting them to parties and events.
sentences.zh: 她甚至不介意迈克尔与前妻和其它孩子保持亲密关系，邀请他们参加派对和活动。

sentences.en: Michael appeared to be a changed man.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔似乎已经判若两人。

sentences.en: While his ex-wife reported that he had been abusive to her in the past, she noted that he didn't display the same temperament with Stacey, who came across as being in charge
sentences.zh: 虽然他的前妻反映他过去曾虐待过她，但她指出他在斯泰西面前并没有表现出那种暴躁脾气，斯泰西在

sentences.en: in the relationship.
sentences.zh: 这段关系中显得占据主导地位。

sentences.en: In her words,
sentences.zh: 用她的话说，

sentences.en: Stacey had tamed Mike.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西把迈克尔驯服了。

sentences.en: But although Michael had become a more settled family man, he was unable to leave his partying ways behind.
sentences.zh: 但尽管迈克尔变成了一个更安稳顾家的男人，他还是无法彻底戒掉派对狂欢的习气。

sentences.en: He still occasionally drank and used drugs, issues he had dealt with throughout his life, which sometimes brought out the worst in him.
sentences.zh: 他偶尔还是会喝酒吸毒，这些伴随了他一生的问题有时会激发出他最坏的一面。

sentences.en: But, at his core,
sentences.zh: 但在内心深处，

sentences.en: Stacey still considered Michael to be a good man and to those close to them agreed that he adored Stacey.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西仍然认为迈克尔是个好人，亲近他们的人也一致认为他深爱着斯泰西。

sentences.en: While they disagreed at times, the first few years of the Wallace marriage were good.
sentences.zh: 虽然有时会有分歧，但华莱士婚姻的前几年还是很美好的。

sentences.en: Three years in,
sentences.zh: 三年后，

sentences.en: Stacey gave birth to the couple's second daughter,
sentences.zh: 斯泰西生下了两人的第二个女儿，

sentences.en: Brie.
sentences.zh: 布里。

sentences.en: Michael took to Brie immediately, considering her his little angel.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔对布里疼爱有加，视她为自己的小天使。

sentences.en: As Brie quickly became
sentences.zh: 随着布里迅速成为

sentences.en: Michael's favourite, his oldest daughter,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的最爱，他的大女儿

sentences.en: Ashley, started to receive less attention from him.
sentences.zh: 阿什利开始受到他较少的关注。

sentences.en: Stacey noticed and stepped in to fill the gap, spending as much time with Ashley as she could.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西注意到了这一点并介入填补空缺，尽可能多地陪伴阿什利。

sentences.en: They formed a strong bond that Stacey described as going beyond mother and daughter to that of best friends.
sentences.zh: 他们建立了一种深厚的羁绊，斯泰西形容这种关系超越了母女，更像是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: While Ashley felt the same way, she didn't entirely agree with how her relationship with Michael was perceived.
sentences.zh: 虽然阿什利也有同感，但她并不完全认同别人对她与迈克尔关系的看法。

sentences.en: She didn't recall ever feeling rejected by him and remembered her childhood with him fondly.
sentences.zh: 她不记得自己曾感到被他拒绝过，并且对与他在一起的童年时光有着美好的回忆。

sentences.en: Throughout this time,
sentences.zh: 在此期间，

sentences.en: Stacey was employed as an ambulance dispatcher and Michael worked as a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西是一名救护车调度员，而迈克尔是一名机械师。

sentences.en: They didn't have much money, but they were comfortable.
sentences.zh: 他们虽然没有太多钱，但也算衣食无忧。

sentences.en: From the outside, the four-member Wallace family appeared to be a normal, functional unit.
sentences.zh: 从外表上看，华莱士一家四口似乎是一个正常、功能健全的家庭。

sentences.en: But by the time
sentences.zh: 但到了

sentences.en: Stacey and Michael had been married a decade, the dynamic between them had shifted, with accusations of infidelity on both sides.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西和迈克尔结婚十年之际，两人的关系动态已经发生了转变，双方都指责对方不忠。

sentences.en: Stacey confided in a friend that she was considering divorce, but always had reasons for not going through with it.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西曾向一位朋友吐露她正在考虑离婚，但总是有一大堆理由让她最终没有付诸行动。

sentences.en: Then, in late 1999,
sentences.zh: 接着，在1999年底，

sentences.en: Michael began to get sick.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔开始生病。

sentences.en: He told a doctor that he felt like he was constantly drunk, even though he hadn't been drinking.
sentences.zh: 他告诉医生，他感觉自己好像一直在醉酒，尽管他根本没喝酒。

sentences.en: He described feeling dizzy and recalled one instance where he couldn't stand up from the toilet.
sentences.zh: 他描述自己感到头晕，并回忆起有一次他甚至无法从马桶上站起来。

sentences.en: Tests ruled out low blood pressure, infection, and diabetes, but no clear course was found.
sentences.zh: 检查排除了低血压、感染和糖尿病，但没有找到明确的病因。

sentences.en: As time wore on,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: Michael's condition worsened.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的病情恶化了。

sentences.en: He developed a hacking cough, became short of breath and bloated, and his skin turned dark purple.
sentences.zh: 他出现了剧烈的咳嗽，开始气短、腹胀，皮肤变成了深紫色。

sentences.en: He complained of shoulder and back pain and had no energy.
sentences.zh: 他抱怨肩膀和背部疼痛，且浑身无力。

sentences.en: Doctors still couldn't figure out what was wrong with him, but others suspected heart disease.
sentences.zh: 医生仍然找不出他到底哪里出了问题，但其他人怀疑是心脏病。

sentences.en: Perhaps his lifestyle was finally catching up with him.
sentences.zh: 也许他的生活方式终于开始对他的身体产生恶果了。

sentences.en: On Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 在周二，

sentences.en: January 11, 2000,
12-year-old Ashley recalled seeing her father lying listlessly on the couch and making unusual movements.
sentences.zh: 12岁的阿什利回忆说，她看到父亲无力地躺在沙发上，并做出了一些不寻常的动作。

sentences.en: At one point, one of his arms shot up into the air, then held out to the side before dropping back down.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，他的一只手臂突然向上举起，然后向旁边伸开，接着又垂了下去。

sentences.en: Ashley went to pick up her younger sister Bree from school and when they returned home, there was an ambulance in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 阿什利去接小妹妹布里放学，当她们回到家时，发现车道上停着一辆救护车。

sentences.en: Their mother came out and told them to go wait at a neighbour's house.
sentences.zh: 他们的母亲走出来，叫她们去邻居家等着。

sentences.en: They were later told that their father had died.
sentences.zh: 后来他们被告知父亲已经去世了。

sentences.en: Michael Wallace's death was presumed to have been the result of a heart attack, with the shoulder and back pain he reported being seen as a warning sign.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·华莱士的死被推定为心脏病发作，他所报告的肩背疼痛被视为一种警告信号。

sentences.en: However, it was never confirmed because Stacey didn't request an autopsy.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一点从未得到证实，因为斯泰西没有要求进行尸检。

sentences.en: At Michael's funeral, attendees were struck by how stoic she seemed.
sentences.zh: 在迈克尔的葬礼上，出席者对她表现出的冷漠感到震惊。

sentences.en: In fact, no one recalled seeing her cry at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，没有人记得曾看到她哭过。

sentences.en: In their view, she didn't present as a typical grieving widow.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，她一点也不像一个典型的悲伤遗孀。

sentences.en: Even Ashley and Bree noticed their mother's unshakable composure, though they assumed she was just trying to stay strong for them.
sentences.zh: 甚至阿什利和布里也注意到了母亲那不可动摇的镇定，尽管她们以为母亲只是在努力为她们坚强。

sentences.en: Stacey explained that she had intentionally chosen to remain calm in the face of tragedy as an example for her daughters.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西解释说，她在面对悲剧时故意选择保持平静，以此作为女儿们的榜样。

sentences.en: She didn't want to act like a widow, but a mother, which was her priority.
sentences.zh: 她不想表现得像个寡妇，而是要像个母亲，这是她的首要任务。

sentences.en: Others were impressed and admired her strength.
sentences.zh: 其他人则对她深表敬佩。

sentences.en: Stacey collected
sentences.zh: 斯泰西领取了

sentences.en: Michael's $50,000 life insurance payout and used the money to pay for his funeral, settle some debts, and take her daughters on a vacation.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的5万美元人寿保险赔偿金，并用这笔钱支付了葬礼费用、还清了一些债务，还带着女儿们去度假。

sentences.en: The trio appeared to adapt to Michael's absence surprisingly quickly, seeming happy again almost overnight.
sentences.zh: 这三母女似乎出奇地快就适应了迈克尔的缺席，几乎一夜之间又恢复了快乐。

sentences.en: That sense of stability was shaken when Stacey met
sentences.zh: 这种稳定感在斯泰西遇到

sentences.en: David Castor two years later in 2002.
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡斯特两年后（即2002年）被打破了。

sentences.en: Another whirlwind romance followed and they married the following year.
sentences.zh: 随后又是一场旋风般的恋爱，他们在第二年结婚了。

sentences.en: While Stacey was happy with David, her daughters were not and tension within the household persisted up until his death.
sentences.zh: 虽然斯泰西对大卫很满意，但她的女儿们并不高兴，家里的紧张气氛一直持续到他去世。

sentences.en: Just as she had after the death of her first husband,
sentences.zh: 就像她在第一任丈夫死后一样，

sentences.en: Stacey appeared to recover from their tragedy quickly and with little outward mourning.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西似乎很快就从悲剧中恢复过来，表面上几乎没有流露出多少悲伤。

sentences.en: Once again, she maintained that she wanted to set a good example for her daughters.
sentences.zh: 她再次坚称，她想为女儿们树立一个好榜样。

sentences.en: Ashley and Bree were relieved that life felt peaceful and happy again like it had before their mother met David.
sentences.zh: 阿什利和布里感到松了一口气，因为生活又像她们的母亲遇到大卫之前那样平静和幸福了。

sentences.en: Privately, some people thought it was strange that Stacey had lost two husbands within the span of five years.
sentences.zh: 私下里，有些人觉得奇怪，斯泰西居然在五年内失去了两个丈夫。

sentences.en: They told themselves that she simply had bad luck, but in the weeks after David Castor's death, investigators weren't so sure.
sentences.zh: 他们安慰自己说她只是运气不好，但在大卫·卡斯特死后的几周里，调查人员可不这么认为。

sentences.en: The similarities between David and Michael's deaths were too precise to be dismissed as mere coincidence or misfortune.
sentences.zh: 大卫和迈克尔死因的相似度太高了，不能仅仅当作巧合或不幸来打发。

sentences.en: They were particularly struck by the fact that Michael had exhibited symptoms of alcohol intoxication while insisting that he hadn't been drinking.
sentences.zh: 让他们尤为震惊的是，迈克尔曾表现出酒精中毒的症状，却坚称自己没有喝酒。

sentences.en: David's death had been similar, with antifreeze poisoning mimicking the effects of alcohol intoxication.
sentences.zh: 大卫的死也很相似，防冻液中毒模拟出了酒精中毒的效果。

sentences.en: The possibility that Stacey could have also been responsible for the death of her first husband intensified the investigation into her.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西也可能对她第一任丈夫的死负有责任的可能性，加剧了对她的调查。

sentences.en: Her phones were tapped and covert surveillance cameras were installed in locations she frequently visited, including the cemetery where her two former husbands were buried
sentences.zh: 她的电话被监听了，秘密监控摄像头被安装在她经常去的地方，包括安葬着她前夫的墓地，两人

sentences.en: side by side.
sentences.zh: 并排长眠于此。

sentences.en: This camera was useful for what it didn't capture.
sentences.zh: 这个摄像头的有用之处在于它没有拍到的内容。

sentences.en: At no point was Stacey recorded visiting either man's grave, not even on the anniversary of David's death.
sentences.zh: 在任何时候，录像都没有拍到斯泰西去探望过两人的坟墓，甚至在大卫的忌日也没有。

sentences.en: Given that
sentences.zh: 鉴于

sentences.en: Michael Wallace's body hadn't undergone an autopsy, investigators made the decision to exhume his remains.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·华莱士的遗体没有进行过尸检，调查人员做出了对其开棺验尸的决定。

sentences.en: What was left of Michael's organs were tested and no sign of heart disease was found.
sentences.zh: 对迈克尔残留的器官进行了检测，没有发现心脏病的迹象。

sentences.en: A sample of his kidney was examined under a microscope and crystals were identified.
sentences.zh: 在显微镜下检查了他的肾脏样本，并发现了晶体。

sentences.en: The crystals were compared to those found in David Castor's kidneys which had been caused by the antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 这些晶体与在大卫·卡斯特肾脏中发现的、由防冻液引起的晶体进行了比对。

sentences.en: To the shock of investigators, they were a match.
sentences.zh: 令调查人员震惊的是，它们竟然完全吻合。

sentences.en: While this discovery confirmed that
sentences.zh: 虽然这一发现证实了

sentences.en: Michael had also died as a result of antifreeze poisoning, testing also revealed that he had ingested rat poison.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔也是死于防冻液中毒，但检测还显示他曾摄入过老鼠药。

sentences.en: This weakened the already highly unlikely possibility that Michael might have impulsively taken his life using antifreeze and pointed toward a more sustained and deliberate pattern
sentences.zh: 这削弱了迈克尔可能冲动地使用防冻液自杀这一本就极其微小的可能性，并指向了一种长期且蓄意的

sentences.en: of poisoning over time.
sentences.zh: 持续下毒模式。

sentences.en: And because
sentences.zh: 而且由于

sentences.en: Michael had sought medical help for his worsening symptoms, it further suggested that he didn't want to die and wasn't fully aware of what was happening to him.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔曾因不断恶化的症状寻求医疗帮助，这进一步表明他并不想死，也并非完全清楚自己身上究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: Stacey Castor was informed that Michael
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·卡斯特尔被告知迈克尔

sentences.en: Wallace's body had been exhumed and that evidence of antifreeze had been found in his remains, but investigators intentionally withheld the information about the rat poison.
sentences.zh: 华莱士的遗体已被掘出，其遗骸中发现了防冻剂的成分，但调查人员故意隐瞒了关于老鼠药的信息。

sentences.en: In response,
sentences.zh: 对此，

sentences.en: Stacey made a cryptic comment saying,
sentences.zh: 斯泰西发表了一番意味深长的话，

sentences.en: I'm sick of being controlled by someone from the grave.
sentences.zh: 她说：我厌倦了被一个来自坟墓的人控制。

sentences.en: In a subsequent three-hour interview,
sentences.zh: 在随后长达三个小时的审讯中，

sentences.en: Stacey was asked to clarify how many times she had called
sentences.zh: 斯泰西被要求澄清，在周五

sentences.en: David Castor between Friday
sentences.zh: 8月19日至周一

sentences.en: August 19 and Monday
sentences.zh: 8月22日期间，她打电话给

sentences.en: August 22 before she called the police to request a welfare check.
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡斯特尔的频率是多少，然后她才打电话给警察要求进行福利查访。

sentences.en: She stated that she had called from her cell phone every 30 to 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 她声称自己每隔30到45分钟就会用手机打一次电话。

sentences.en: Investigators already knew from her phone records that no such calls had taken place.
sentences.zh: 调查人员从她的通话记录中已经得知，根本没有发生过这样的通话。

sentences.en: They then asked Stacey to repeat details from her original statement regarding David's death, some of which she now described differently.
sentences.zh: 他们随后要求斯泰西重复她最初关于大卫之死的陈述中的细节，其中一些细节她现在的描述与以前不同了。

sentences.en: When shown an image of the glasses on David's nightstand,
sentences.zh: 当被出示大卫床头柜上水杯的照片时，

sentences.en: Stacey pointed to an empty one and began explaining that she had brought him cranberry juice but then misspoke.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西指向一个空杯子，开始解释说她给他拿了蔓越莓汁，但随后说漏了嘴。

sentences.en: She said, well, I poured the antifree, I mean, I poured the cranberry juice into this glass.
sentences.zh: 她说，好吧，我把防冻，我是说，我把蔓越莓汁倒进了这个杯子里。

sentences.en: When told her fingerprints were found on the glass containing the antifreeze,
sentences.zh: 当被告知在盛有防冻剂的杯子上发现了她的指纹时，

sentences.en: Stacey abruptly replied,
sentences.zh: 斯泰西生硬地回答道：

sentences.en: that's it,
sentences.zh: 就这样吧，

sentences.en: I'm done,
sentences.zh: 我不干了，

sentences.en: I want an attorney.
sentences.zh: 我要找律师。

sentences.en: She stopped answering questions and got up to leave.
sentences.zh: 她停止回答问题并起身准备离开。

sentences.en: Before she left, she noticed a close-up photograph of the turkey baster recovered from her kitchen trash bin.
sentences.zh: 在她离开之前，她注意到了从她厨房垃圾桶里找到的火鸡抽油管的特写照片。

sentences.en: Clearly unsettled, she wanted to know about it, but an investigator replied, sorry, you've discontinued the interview, I can't talk to you anymore.
sentences.zh: 她明显感到不安，想了解情况，但一名调查人员回答说：抱歉，你已经终止了审讯，我不能再跟你说话了。

sentences.en: Stacey denied any involvement in either
sentences.zh: 斯泰西否认自己与

sentences.en: Michael or
sentences.zh: 迈克尔或

sentences.en: David's deaths.
sentences.zh: 大卫的死有任何牵连。

sentences.en: While she remained under suspicion, she eventually visited their graves.
sentences.zh: 尽管她依然受到怀疑，但她最终还是去拜访了他们的坟墓。

sentences.en: Cameras recorded her showing little emotion and she left shortly after.
sentences.zh: 摄像机记录下她几乎没有表现出什么情绪，不久后便离开了。

sentences.en: Investigators interpreted the visit as being less about paying respects and more about confirming whether
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，这次拜访与其说是为了表达敬意，不如说是为了确认

sentences.en: Michael's body had been exhumed.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的遗体是否真的被掘出了。

sentences.en: Phone taps captured her speaking with friends, expressing anxiety about the investigation and insisting that she hadn't killed either man.
sentences.zh: 窃听器捕捉到她与朋友交谈，对调查表示焦虑，并坚称她没有杀害这两个男人。

sentences.en: She also said she didn't believe the claims that antifreeze had been found in
sentences.zh: 她还表示，她不相信迈克尔

sentences.en: Michael's body.
sentences.zh: 遗体中发现防冻剂的说法。

sentences.en: A little over a week after the discovery that Michael
sentences.zh: 在发现迈克尔

sentences.en: Wallace had been poisoned, on the morning of
sentences.zh: 华莱士被毒死的一个多星期后，

sentences.en: Friday,
sentences.zh: 周五的早晨，

sentences.en: September 14,
Brie Wallace was walking down the hallway of her home when she heard something strange.
sentences.zh: 布里·华莱士正走在家里的走廊里，突然听到奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: It sounded like shallow gasps and strained moans coming from her older sister's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是从她姐姐卧室里传出的微弱喘息声和痛苦的呻吟声。

sentences.en: Brie opened the door and saw 20-year-old
sentences.zh: 布里推开门，看到20岁的

sentences.en: Ashley lying at the foot of the bed with pillows piled on top of her head.
sentences.zh: 阿什利躺在床尾，头上堆满了枕头。

sentences.en: Brie removed them and found
sentences.zh: 布里拿开枕头，发现

sentences.en: Ashley in a catatonic state.
sentences.zh: 阿什利呈紧张症状态。
