sentences.zh: 窃听器记录下了这段对话，期间史黛西说阿诗礼正在房间里睡觉，呼吸和流口水都很正常。

sentences.en: Later that night, Matthew went to the Castor family home.
sentences.zh: 那天深夜，马修来到了卡斯特一家的住所。

sentences.en: From outside, he noticed Ashley's room was dark and repeatedly called her cell phone.
sentences.zh: 从外面看，他注意到阿诗礼的房间是一片漆黑，于是多次拨打她的手机。

sentences.en: Eventually, Stacey answered.
sentences.zh: 最终，史黛西接了电话。

sentences.en: Matthew was surprised as this had never happened before.
sentences.zh: 马修感到很惊讶，因为以前从未发生过这种事。

sentences.en: Stacey told him to call back on the landline, apparently unaware it was being monitored.
sentences.zh: 史黛西让他打座机再拨过来，显然她并没有意识到电话正在被监听。

sentences.en: When he did, Matthew asked to speak with Ashley, but Stacey said she was asleep and couldn't be disturbed.
sentences.zh: 当他打过去时，马修要求与阿诗礼通话，但史黛西说她已经睡着了，不能被打扰。

sentences.en: Thinking quickly, he asked for a favour.
sentences.zh: 他脑子转得很快，便请求帮个忙。

sentences.en: Without telling Stacey that he was outside the house,
sentences.zh: 在没有告诉史黛西自己就在房子外面这一点的情况下

sentences.en: Matthew said that he had lost his ATM card and suspected it might be in Ashley's room.
sentences.zh: 马修说他把ATM卡弄丢了，怀疑可能掉在了阿诗礼的房间里。

sentences.en: Stacey agreed to go and look for it.
sentences.zh: 史黛西同意去帮他找找。

sentences.en: A short time later, Stacey returned to the phone to report that Matthew's card was not there.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，史黛西回到电话旁报告说马修的卡不在那里。

sentences.en: Matthew was incredulous.
sentences.zh: 马修感到难以置信。

sentences.en: He'd been watching the house and hadn't seen a light go on in Ashley's bedroom, suggesting Stacey had never gone in there to look.
sentences.zh: 他一直在盯着房子，根本没看到阿诗礼卧室的灯亮过，这表明史黛西压根就没进去找过。

sentences.en: As the night continued, Stacey hosted a small gathering in the backyard while Ashley remained in her room, supposedly asleep.
sentences.zh: 夜色渐深，史黛西在后院办了一个小型聚会，而阿诗礼则留在房间里，据称是在睡觉。

sentences.en: About 18 hours after she had drunk the vodka cocktail, Ashley was found on the brink of death by her younger sister.
sentences.zh: 在喝下那杯伏特加鸡尾酒大约18小时后，阿诗礼被她的妹妹发现时已经奄奄一息。

sentences.en: An examination of the Castor family's computer revealed that the supposed suicide note had been written in stages over time.
sentences.zh: 对卡斯特家族电脑的检查显示，那封所谓的遗书是分阶段、历时写成的。

sentences.en: Two drafts were saved, which differed slightly from the final version found in Ashley's bed, with the last recorded access occurring on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 保存了两个草稿，与在阿诗礼床上发现的最终版本略有不同，最后一次记录的访问时间是星期三

sentences.en: September 12, 2007, two days before Ashley was hospitalised.
sentences.zh: 2007年9月12日，即阿诗礼住院两天前。

sentences.en: This coincided with the day Ashley was questioned by police and told that her father had been poisoned.
sentences.zh: 这与阿诗礼被警方盘问并被告知父亲被下毒的那天是同一天。

sentences.en: The emerging story was that, after realising police had discovered Michael Wallace had been murdered, Ashley knew the jig was up and decided to take her own life.
sentences.zh: 新浮出水面的说法是，在意识到警方发现迈克尔·华莱士是被谋杀的之后，阿诗礼知道自己大限已到，便决定自寻短见。

sentences.en: But first, she typed out a full confession in a suicide note, also admitting to having murdered David Castor.
sentences.zh: 但在此之前，她在一封遗书中打出了完整的供词，同时也承认杀害了大卫·卡斯特。

sentences.en: Yet, this theory didn't align with the evidence.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一理论与证据并不吻合。

sentences.en: The suicide note was last accessed on the Castor computer at 2.27pm.
sentences.zh: 这封遗书最后一次在卡斯特的电脑上被访问是在下午2点27分。

sentences.en: At that time, Ashley was in class on campus.
sentences.zh: 当时，阿诗礼正在校园里上课。

sentences.en: Stacey, however, was at home.
sentences.zh: 而史黛西却在家。

sentences.en: She picked Ashley up at around 3.30pm to begin their impromptu drinking session.
sentences.zh: 她在下午3点30分左右接了阿诗礼，开始他们突发奇想的饮酒聚会。

sentences.en: Notably, some words in the note were spelled correctly in one section, but misspelled elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，遗书中的某些词在某一部分拼写正确，但在其他地方却拼写错误。

sentences.en: This suggested that the author had deliberately dumbed down the content in order to distance themselves from it, but had done so inconsistently.
sentences.zh: 这表明作者为了与内容保持距离而故意降低了内容的智商水平，但这种做法前后不一致。

sentences.en: It was also striking that the letter focused less on Ashley's apparent guilt or remorse, which were typically the central themes of
sentences.zh: 同样引人注目的是，这封信没有过多关注阿诗礼表面的罪恶感或悔恨之情，而这通常是

sentences.en: a suicide note, and more on asserting Stacey's complete innocence in Michael and David's deaths.
sentences.zh: 遗书的核心主题，相反，它更多地强调史黛西在迈克尔和大卫的死中完全是清白的。

sentences.en: This point was repeated at least 14 different ways throughout.
sentences.zh: 这一点在整篇遗书中以至少14种不同的方式反复提及。

sentences.en: But it was the mention of rat poison that really intrigued investigators.
sentences.zh: 但真正激起调查人员兴趣的是对老鼠药的提及。

sentences.en: The rat poison had been discovered in Michael's system after his body was exhumed, but authorities had deliberately kept that detail under wraps.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的尸体被掘出后，在他的体内发现了老鼠药，但当局故意将这一细节保密。

sentences.en: It was information only his killer could have known, and meant that whoever had written the note was the one who had killed Michael
sentences.zh: 这是只有凶手才知道的信息，这意味着写下这封信的人就是杀害迈克尔的人

sentences.en: Wallace.
sentences.zh: 华莱士。

sentences.en: In the note, the word antifreeze was misspelled as antifree.
sentences.zh: 在信中，防冻液（antifreeze）一词被拼写成了错误的形式。

sentences.en: While this could have been dismissed as a simple spelling error, investigators recalled a prior interview with Stacey during which
sentences.zh: 虽然这可以被当作一个简单的拼写错误而不予理睬，但调查人员回想起之前对史黛西的一次采访，当时

sentences.en: she had referred to filling David's glass with antifree before quickly correcting herself to say it was cranberry juice.
sentences.zh: 她曾提到自己往大卫的杯子里倒了防冻液，然后赶紧纠正说那是蔓越莓汁。

sentences.en: They wondered whether she had intended to say antifreeze, but had cut herself
sentences.zh: 他们纳闷她当时是不是想说防冻液，却在

sentences.en: off mid-word, or whether she in fact had a habit of referring to it as antifree, which would provide a strong potential link to her being the author of the suicide note.
sentences.zh: 话说到一半时戛然而止，或者她其实有把防冻液简称为某个词的习惯，这将成为她可能就是遗书作者的一个强有力潜在关联。

sentences.en: This link was strengthened when investigators compared the note to samples of Stacey's writing, which revealed identical idiosyncratic grammar and word usage.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员将这封信与史黛西的字迹样本进行对比时，这种关联得到了加强，对比结果显示两者的语法和用词习惯完全相同。

sentences.en: Although Stacey said she hadn't read the note, she still referred to it as a suicide note, clarifying that she had read the first couple of lines before stopping.
sentences.zh: 尽管史黛西说她没有读过这封信，但她仍然称其为遗书，并澄清说她读了前两行就停下来了。

sentences.en: While she wouldn't openly claim that Ashley had authored the note, she maintained that she hadn't written it herself.
sentences.zh: 虽然她不愿公开声称阿诗礼是这封信的作者，但她坚称这不是她自己写的。

sentences.en: She accepted its contents and said she fully believed that Ashley had killed both of her husbands.
sentences.zh: 她接受了信中的内容，并表示她坚信阿诗礼杀害了她的两位丈夫。

sentences.en: Investigators had long intended to arrest Stacey, but had been cautiously taking their time to gather solid evidence.
sentences.zh: 调查人员早就打算逮捕史黛西，但为了收集确凿的证据，他们一直小心翼翼地放慢节奏。

sentences.en: Now that it was looking like she was willing to harm her own children to avoid suspicion, they moved forward and placed her under arrest for the murder of David Castor and the
sentences.zh: 既然现在看来她为了洗脱嫌疑宁愿伤害自己的亲生孩子，他们便果断采取行动，以谋杀大卫·卡斯特和

sentences.en: attempted murder of Ashley Wallace.
sentences.zh: 谋杀未遂阿诗礼·华莱士的罪名将她逮捕。

sentences.en: While investigators were convinced that Stacey was also responsible for
sentences.zh: 虽然调查人员确信史黛西也应对

sentences.en: Michael Wallace's death, they proceeded with the charges they were most confident would secure a conviction.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·华莱士的死负责，但他们还是以最有把握确保定罪的罪名进行了起诉。

sentences.en: Stacey appeared largely unfazed during the booking process, treating the situation as though it were a big mistake.
sentences.zh: 在登记入册的过程中，史黛西看起来基本无动于衷，把这种情况当成是一个巨大的误会。

sentences.en: She said her children were her whole life and insisted that anyone who knew her would attest to the fact that she'd never hurt them.
sentences.zh: 她说她的孩子是她生命的全部，并坚称任何认识她的人都可以作证，证明她绝不会伤害他们。

sentences.en: She maintained that Michael had died of natural causes, that David had taken his own life, and that Ashley intended to do the same.
sentences.zh: 她坚称迈克尔是死于自然原因，大卫是自杀身亡，而阿诗礼也打算这样做。

sentences.en: Stacey said she was not even remotely guilty and insisted that she had loved both of her husbands.
sentences.zh: 史黛西说她毫无罪责感，并坚称自己深爱着两位丈夫。

sentences.en: She revealed two tattoos, one on each shoulder, which she had gotten after their deaths.
sentences.zh: 她露出了两个纹身，左右肩膀各一个，这是他们在世时她纹的。

sentences.en: Each depicted a teddy bear with the man's birth date above and the date of his death below.
sentences.zh: 每个纹身上都画着一只泰迪熊，上面写着男人的出生日期，下面写着他的忌日。

sentences.en: She continued to assert that the wrong person had been arrested and that her innocence would be proven.
sentences.zh: 她继续坚称抓错了人，并声称自己的清白终将得到证明。

sentences.en: Even some of Stacey's closest relatives and friends believed that Ashley was the real killer.
sentences.zh: 甚至史黛西的一些至亲好友也相信阿诗礼才是真正的凶手。

sentences.en: They accepted the notion that Ashley, despite being just 12 years old at the time of her father's death, had devised, carried out and nearly
sentences.zh: 他们接受了这样一种观念：阿诗礼在父亲去世时年仅12岁，却在两次不同的场合精心策划、实施并险些

sentences.en: succeeded in an elaborate poisoning scheme on two separate occasions.
sentences.zh: 成功实施了一场复杂的投毒计划。

sentences.en: They portrayed Ashley as jealous of the attention Michael gave to her sister, Bree, suggesting that this motivated her to commit murder.
sentences.zh: 他们把阿诗礼描绘成嫉妒迈克尔给予她姐姐布里关爱的人，暗示这是她实施谋杀的动机。

sentences.en: They also pointed to her conflicts with David as further evidence of instability.
sentences.zh: 他们还指出她与大卫的冲突是不稳定的进一步证据。

sentences.en: I've seen her temper, one person said, suggesting it was enough to prove she was capable of double homicide.
sentences.zh: 我见过她的脾气，一个人说，暗示这足以证明她有能力实施双重谋杀。

sentences.en: Stacey encouraged the suggestion that a 12-year-old was fully capable of premeditated murder, telling an ABC reporter after her arrest,
sentences.zh: 史黛西助长了这样一种说法，即一个12岁的孩子完全有能力实施谋杀，她在被捕后对美国广播公司（ABC）的一名记者说，

sentences.en: Ashley struggled in the aftermath of her mother's arreSt. She couldn't understand why Stacey wasn't defending her and instead trying to implicate her in the murders.
sentences.zh: 在母亲被捕后，阿诗礼的生活陷入了困境。她无法理解为什么史黛西没有为她辩护，反而试图将她牵连进谋杀案中。

sentences.en: For someone she previously considered her best friend, it was a crushing blow.
sentences.zh: 对于一个她以前认为最好的朋友的人来说，这是一个毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: I would have done anything for her, Ashley said.
sentences.zh: 我愿意为她做任何事，阿诗礼说。

sentences.en: She tried to kill me instead.
sentences.zh: 而她却反过来试图杀死我。

sentences.en: When she was discharged from hospital, reporters asked her how she felt after her suicide attempt.
sentences.zh: 当她出院时，记者们问她自杀未遂后感觉如何。

sentences.en: Ashley pushed back, clarifying that she hadn't tried to kill herself and that her mother had drugged her.
sentences.zh: 阿诗礼予以回击，澄清说她并没有试图自杀，而是她母亲给她下了药。

sentences.en: When asked why her mother would do such a thing, Ashley responded, she must have been looking for an easy way out.
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么她母亲会做出这种事时，阿诗礼回答说，她一定是在寻找一条轻松脱身的退路。

sentences.en: The mother versus daughter narrative made for compelling tabloid coverage, with both women steadfastly claiming they were being framed by the other.
sentences.zh: 母亲与女儿的对立叙事为小报提供了引人入胜的头条新闻，两个女人都坚信自己是被对方陷害的。

sentences.en: While the ordeal took a heavy toll on Ashley,
sentences.zh: 虽然这场磨难给阿诗礼带来了沉重的打击，但

sentences.en: Stacey appeared to cope well, showing little visible emotion.
sentences.zh: 史黛西看起来应对得很好，几乎没有表现出明显的感情波动。

sentences.en: She seemed unfazed that neither of her daughters reached out to her in custody awaiting trial, convinced that they would eventually reconcile,
sentences.zh: 在等待审判被关押期间，她的两个女儿都没有主动联系她，她对此似乎也无动于衷，坚信她们最终会和好，

sentences.en: even though both Ashley and Bree were vocal about wanting nothing to do with her.
sentences.zh: 尽管阿诗礼和布里都明确表示不想和她有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: By the time Stacey faced a jury in January 2009, she had been hit with an additional charge relating to
sentences.zh: 到2009年1月史黛西出庭受审时，她已经被追加了一项与

sentences.en: David's fraudulent will.
sentences.zh: 大卫伪造遗嘱有关的指控。

sentences.en: The defence fought hard to maintain her innocence, arguing that the simplest explanation was the correct one, that Ashley's suicide note was genuine and she had written it herself.
sentences.zh: 辩护方拼力维护她的清白，辩称最简单的解释往往就是正确的，即阿诗礼的遗书是真的，而且是她自己写的。

sentences.en: They didn't shy away from the implication, stating, the guilty person is Ashley Wallace and not Stacey Castor.
sentences.zh: 他们毫不避讳这种暗示，声称：有罪的人是阿诗礼·华莱士，而不是史黛西·卡斯特。

sentences.en: The suggestion that Ashley was the killer formed the crux of the defence's case.
sentences.zh: 阿诗礼是凶手的暗示构成了辩护方核心辩护案情的基础。

sentences.en: They framed the case against Stacey as a miscarriage of justice, arguing that the evidence against her was purely circumstantial and based on an assembly of guesses and theories.
sentences.zh: 他们将针对史黛西的案件诬陷为冤假错案，辩称对她的指控纯属间接证据，完全建立在一堆猜测和理论之上。

sentences.en: They accused police of having decided on Stacey's guilt from the outset, arguing that this bias meant they hadn't properly considered alternative explanations.
sentences.zh: 他们指责警方从一开始就认定斯泰西有罪，并认为这种偏见导致警方没有认真考虑其他可能的解释。

sentences.en: After all, they had bugged Stacey's phone and kept her under surveillance, but didn't do that to Ashley.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他们监听了斯泰西的电话并对她进行了监视，却没有对阿什利这样做。

sentences.en: While they acknowledged it would be disingenuous to suggest that none of the evidence raised suspicion
sentences.zh: 尽管他们承认，如果暗示所有证据都没有引起怀疑，那就太虚伪了，

sentences.en: against Stacey, they maintained that if she was the killer, there were certain things about the case
sentences.zh: 针对斯泰西的怀疑确实存在，但他们坚称，如果她是凶手，案情中有某些地方

sentences.en: that didn't fit, adding, on the flip side of that, you will say that the evidence makes sense only if
sentences.zh: 说不通；反过来说，他们会认为，只有当阿什利·华莱士是凶手时，

sentences.en: Ashley Wallace is the killer.
sentences.zh: 这些证据才讲得通。

sentences.en: More importantly, they claimed there was nothing that definitively excluded Ashley, whom they described as spoiled and ungrateful, and asserted she had every opportunity
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他们声称没有任何证据能绝对排除阿什利的嫌疑——他们将阿什利描述为一个被宠坏且忘恩负义的人——并断言她有充分的机会

sentences.en: to do everything she claimed in the letter.
sentences.zh: 去完成她在信中所述的一切。

sentences.en: Ashley Wallace testified at her mother's trial, marking the first time the pair had been in the same room since Ashley was hospitalised.
sentences.zh: 阿什利·华莱士在母亲的审判中出庭作证，这是自阿什利住院以来两人首次共处一室。

sentences.en: She didn't make eye contact with her mother once during her three-hour testimony.
sentences.zh: 在她长达三个小时的作证过程中，她一次也没有与母亲对视。

sentences.en: Ashley maintained that she loved her father Michael and that they had a good relationship.
sentences.zh: 阿什利坚称她爱她的父亲迈克尔，并且他们关系很好。

sentences.en: While she admitted she didn't like David very much, she said she had cut him some slack just before he died, and that things
sentences.zh: 虽然她承认自己不太喜欢大卫，但她表示就在他去世前不久，她对他有所宽容，而且

sentences.en: weren't as tense between them because she was working most of the time.
sentences.zh: 由于她大部分时间都在工作，他们之间的关系不像以前那么紧张了。

sentences.en: Ashley said she was aware that
sentences.zh: 阿什利说她知道

sentences.en: David was sick in the bedroom over the weekend before his death, but maintained she was never alone in the house with him during that time.
sentences.zh: 大卫在他去世前的那个周末生病躺在卧室里，但她坚称在那期间她从未独自和他在屋里呆过。

sentences.en: She said she didn't see him at all and was at work when he was found dead.
sentences.zh: 她说她根本没见到他，在他被发现死亡时她正在上班。

sentences.en: Ashley spoke about her mother's unexpected and uncharacteristic suggestion that they get drunk together after Michael was found to have been poisoned.
sentences.zh: 阿什利谈到了她母亲一个意想不到且一反常态的提议：在发现迈克尔是被毒死之后，提议两人一起喝醉。

sentences.en: She described how the first attempt left her feeling sick.
sentences.zh: 她描述了第一次尝试如何让她感到恶心。

sentences.en: The prosecution portrayed this initial incident as a trial run for the actual murder attempt the next day, arguing that Stacey was testing whether Ashley would comply and drink
sentences.zh: 控方将这起最初的事件描绘成对第二天真正的谋杀企图的预演，辩称斯泰西是在试探阿什利是否会顺从而毫不犹豫地喝下

sentences.en: something offered to her without question, even if it tasted off.
sentences.zh: 别人递给她的东西，即使尝起来味道不对。

sentences.en: Asked why she drank the drink her mother gave her even though it tasted awful, Ashley said, because I trusted her.
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么明知母亲给她的饮料味道糟糕却还是喝了时，阿什利回答说，因为我信任她。

sentences.en: She denied attempting to take her own life, and when asked if she had poisoned her father or stepfather with antifreeze, she firmly replied, No, I did not.
sentences.zh: 她否认自己曾企图自杀，当被问及是否用防冻液毒害了她的父亲或继父时，她坚定地回答：“不，我没有。”

sentences.en: The defence worked to suggest that Ashley had a motive to carry out the murders.
sentences.zh: 辩方极力暗示阿什利有杀人的动机。

sentences.en: They pointed out that she knew that her father had alcohol and drug issues that impacted the family.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，她知道她的父亲有酗酒和吸毒问题，这影响了家庭。

sentences.en: They also highlighted her tumultuous relationship with David and her awareness that he
sentences.zh: 他们还强调了她与大卫之间紧张不安的关系，以及她知道大卫

sentences.en: frequently argued with her mother, but went further by alleging that David had molested Ashley when she was 13 years old.
sentences.zh: 经常与她母亲争吵，但更进一步指称大卫在阿什利 13 岁时对她实施了猥亵。

sentences.en: Ashley had never made such an allegation, and there was no evidence to support the suggestion.
sentences.zh: 阿什利从未做出过这样的指控，也没有任何证据支持这种说法。

sentences.en: This line of questioning stopped as quickly as it was established, with observers
sentences.zh: 这种质问刚出现就迅速停止了，观察人士

sentences.en: viewing it as an attempt to provide the jurors with a possible motive for viewing Ashley as the killer, even if the suggestion itself was baseless.
sentences.zh: 认为这是一种企图，即便这种说法本身毫无根据，也要为陪审团提供一个将阿什利视作凶手的可能动机。

sentences.en: The defence produced a letter Ashley had once written to a former boyfriend in which she complained about David and expressed a desire to punch him in the face.
sentences.zh: 辩方出示了一封阿什利曾经写给前男友的信，她在信中抱怨大卫，并表达了想狠狠揍他脸一拳的愿望。

sentences.en: She also wrote that she wanted to leave home, adding that when she moved out her mother would be sorry.
sentences.zh: 她还写道她想离开家，并补充说等她搬出去后母亲会后悔的。

sentences.en: Ashley didn't shy away from acknowledging these feelings.
sentences.zh: 阿什利并没有回避承认这些感受。

sentences.en: She was a moody teenager and made no pretense of liking David, but maintained that it didn't mean she wanted him dead.
sentences.zh: 她曾是一个情绪多变的青少年，也从不伪装自己喜欢大卫，但她坚称这并不意味着她希望他死。

sentences.en: She also didn't deny having written a note during a particularly low point after her father's death, in which she expressed a fascination with death and dying.
sentences.zh: 她也没有否认在父亲去世后情绪极其低落的时期写过一张便条，在便条中她表达了对死亡和垂死的迷恋。

sentences.en: In the note, she wrote that she had attempted suicide twice, but hadn't gone through with it, because, quote,
sentences.zh: 她在便条中写道，她曾两次企图自杀，但都没有付诸行动，因为，引述原话，

sentences.en: each time I thought about my sister and how I couldn't have her here without someone to protect her or someone for her to look up to sometimes.
sentences.zh: 每次一想到我的妹妹，以及没有人在身边保护她或给她树立榜样，我就无法丢下她不管。

sentences.en: The defence's implication was that because Ashley admitted to attempting suicide in the past, she was therefore capable of doing so again.
sentences.zh: 辩方的暗示是，既然阿什利承认过去曾企图自杀，那么她因此也有可能再次这样做。

sentences.en: However, she maintained that there was no third time.
sentences.zh: 然而，她坚称并没有第三次。

sentences.en: Bree Wallace also took the stand.
sentences.zh: 布里·华莱士也出庭作证。

sentences.en: Unlike her older sister, she was far more emotional while testifying, often breaking down in tears and needing to pause to drink water and compose herself.
sentences.zh: 与姐姐不同，她在作证时情绪激动得多，经常泪流满面，需要停下来喝水并平复心情。

sentences.en: She spoke of the morning she found Ashley on the brink of death, saying she had wanted to check on her the previous evening, but Stacy said to leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了她发现阿什利奄奄一息的那天早晨，说她本想在前一天晚上去看看她，但斯泰西说让她一个人呆着。

sentences.en: Bree had nevertheless opened the door and looked in, but Stacy quickly shooed her away, saying,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，布里还是推开门看了一眼，但斯泰西很快把她赶走，说道：

sentences.en: She's fine, leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 她很好，让她一个人呆着。

sentences.en: I want her to sleep through until morning.
sentences.zh: 我想让她一觉睡到天亮。

sentences.en: Stacy sat impassively as her daughters testified, never looking up, but occasionally resting her head on her hand.
sentences.zh: 在女儿们作证时，斯泰西面无表情地坐着，从未抬头，只是偶尔把头靠在手上。

sentences.en: She remained calm and steadfast as she testified in her own defence.
sentences.zh: 在为自己辩护作证时，她保持着平静和坚定。

sentences.en: The first question posed to her by her attorney was whether she had killed Michael Wallace.
sentences.zh: 她的律师向她提出的第一个问题是她是否杀害了迈克尔·华莱士。

sentences.en: No, she replied.
sentences.zh: “没有，”她回答说。

sentences.en: She said she had loved
sentences.zh: 她说她曾

sentences.en: Michael with all of her heart and still did.
sentences.zh: 全心全意地爱着迈克尔，现在依然如此。

sentences.en: But she maintained that he had treated their children differently, describing how he favoured Bree by being present from the moment she was born and calling her princess.
sentences.zh: 但她坚称迈克尔对待他们孩子的态度有所不同，她描述了迈克尔如何偏爱布里，从她出生起就陪伴在她身边并叫她小公主。

sentences.en: Stacy said Michael didn't have the same connection with Ashley, who didn't receive her own affectionate nickname.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西说迈克尔与阿什利没有这种亲密联系，阿什利没有得到专属的亲昵绰号。

sentences.en: She alleged that Michael had spanked Ashley, but not Bree, and described Ashley as having behavioural issues since early childhood.
sentences.zh: 她声称迈克尔曾打过阿什利的屁股，却没有打过布里，并形容阿什利从小就有行为问题。

sentences.en: At Michael's funeral, she recalled that Bree was distraught while Ashley remained stoic.
sentences.zh: 她回忆说，在迈克尔的葬礼上，布里悲痛欲绝，而阿什利则表现得无动于衷。

sentences.en: Stacy also pointed out that she wasn't the only one who felt it was unnecessary to order an autopsy for Michael, noting that his own mother had agreed.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西还指出，并非只有她一人觉得没有必要为迈克尔申请尸检，并指出迈克尔的亲生母亲也表示同意。

sentences.en: As for David Castor, Stacy maintained that she had loved him too.
sentences.zh: 至于大卫·卡斯特，斯泰西坚称她也爱过他。

sentences.en: She repeated her account of his final weekend, describing his heavy drinking following her refusal to go on a trip with him.
sentences.zh: 她重复了对大卫生命中最后一个周末的描述，讲述在她拒绝与他一同旅行后他大量酗酒的情况。

sentences.en: She claimed that on the Friday she had gone to the post office for an hour, during which Ashley was home with David.
sentences.zh: 她声称，在那个星期五她去邮局呆了一个小时，在此期间阿什利在家和大卫在一起。

sentences.en: This was notable, as Ashley's supposed suicide note stated,
sentences.zh: 这很引人注目，因为阿什利所谓的自杀便条上写着：

sentences.en: That Friday, when David came home so you could go to the post office is when I first did it, implying that Ashley had poisoned David while Stacy was out.
sentences.zh: “那个星期五，大卫回家好让你去邮局，那就是我第一次动手的时候，”这暗示阿什利趁斯泰西外出时给大卫下了毒。

sentences.en: What was striking about this testimony was that Stacy never mentioned a post office trip at any point
sentences.zh: 这份证词最令人震惊的是，在漫长的警方调查期间，斯泰西从未

sentences.en: during the prolonged police investigation, including in her many informal and formal interviews.
sentences.zh: 在任何时候提到过邮局之行，包括在她多次非正式和正式的盘问中。

sentences.en: Nor did she ever tell investigators that Ashley had been alone with David at all that weekend.
sentences.zh: 她也从未向调查人员透露过阿什利那个周末曾独自和大卫在一起。

sentences.en: Stacy admitted to having friends sign David's will after his death, a revelation that only further undermined her credibility and suggested a willingness to be deceptive.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西承认在大卫死后曾找朋友在大卫的遗嘱上签字，这一爆料进一步削弱了她的信可度，并表明她愿意撒谎欺骗。

sentences.en: She maintained it was something they had discussed, but never completed, and said she simply wanted to ensure his estate was settled the way he had intended, adding,
sentences.zh: 她坚称这是他们讨论过但未完成的事，并说她只是想确保他的遗产按照他的意愿进行处理，她补充说：

sentences.en: I could never have anticipated in a million years that I would be widowed after two years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没有想到，在结婚两年后我竟然会沦为寡妇。

sentences.en: She also clarified that when she said anti-free during her police interviews, she had intended to say anti-freeze, but stopped herself before finishing the word.
sentences.zh: 她还澄清说，在警察盘问时她说“anti-free”时，本意是想说“防冻液”（anti-freeze），但在把话说完前打住了。

sentences.en: Stacy admitted she had given Ashley a vodka mixer to celebrate her first day of college, but denied giving her any pills.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西承认她曾给阿什利一杯伏特加调酒来庆祝她大学第一天开学，但否认给她吃过任何药丸。

sentences.en: She also denied much of what Ashley had alleged about the events leading up to her hospitalisation, including that she had prepared drinks and forced her to consume them.
sentences.zh: 她还否认了阿什利关于住院前夕发生的事情的许多说法，包括她曾准备饮料并强迫阿什利喝下。

sentences.en: She maintained that whatever Ashley had drunk, she had done so on her own, without Stacy's involvement or approval.
sentences.zh: 她坚称无论阿什利喝了什么，都是她自己喝的，没有斯泰西的参与或同意。

sentences.en: She also didn't find it unusual that Ashley had a long sleep afterward, as she said she was prone to sleeping for extended periods.
sentences.zh: 她也并不觉得阿什利随后长时间睡眠有什么异常，因为她说阿什利本来就容易长时间睡觉。

sentences.en: Stacy claimed she checked on Ashley throughout the night, but only realised something was wrong when Bree found her the next morning.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西声称她整晚都在查看阿什利的情况，直到第二天早上布里发现她时才意识到出事了。

sentences.en: After four weeks of proceedings, the jury took 16 hours to deliberate.
sentences.zh: 经过四周的庭审，陪审团 deliberations（进行了 16 小时）的评议花去了 16 个小时。

sentences.en: Stacy Castor remained characteristically emotionless as she was found guilty of all charges.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·卡斯特在被裁定所有罪名成立时，一如既往地毫无情绪。

sentences.en: The verdict immediately vindicated Ashley Wallace, who embraced her sister Bree as both cried in relief.
sentences.zh: 这项裁决立即还了阿什利·华莱士以清白，她拥抱了妹妹布里，两人因如释重负而痛哭。

sentences.en: Outside court, Ashley expressed her happiness that the whole ordeal was over, saying,
sentences.zh: 法院外，阿什利表达了对这场折磨终于结束的喜悦，说道：

sentences.en: I can honestly say this is the best day of my life, because I knew I didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我可以坦言这是我生命中最美好的一天，因为我知道这件事不是我干的。

sentences.en: Now that I know everybody knows I didn't do it, it's just ten times lighter.
sentences.zh: 现在我知道所有人都知道这不是我干的，感觉整个人轻松了十倍。

sentences.en: While Bree admitted she felt sympathy for her mother, she added,
sentences.zh: 虽然布里承认她对母亲感到一丝同情，但她接着说道：

sentences.en: I was happy they decided she was guilty, because we all knew that was true.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴他们判定她有罪，因为我们都知道那是事实。

sentences.en: When asked if the sisters would ever be able to move on, Ashley said,
sentences.zh: 当被问及姐妹俩是否能彻底放下过去时，阿什利说：

sentences.en: I already have, we already have.
sentences.zh: 我已经放下了，我们早就放下了。

sentences.en: As for whether they would ever speak to their mother again, Ashley said,
sentences.zh: 至于她们是否还会跟母亲说话，阿什利说：

sentences.en: I don't want to talk to her ever again.
sentences.zh: 我再也不想跟她说话了。

sentences.en: I really don't.
sentences.zh: 我是真的不想。

sentences.en: I really have nothing to say to her.
sentences.zh: 我真的没什么话对她讲。

sentences.en: I'm glad she'll be away for a very long time and she can't hurt anybody ever again.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴她将在里面关上很久很久，再也无法伤害任何人了。

sentences.en: In post-trial interviews, jurors revealed that they hadn't found Stacey credible.
sentences.zh: 在庭审后的采访中，陪审员透露他们认为斯泰西并不可信。

sentences.en: Combined with the fact that she had the most access to both victims, this ultimately solidified their guilty verdict.
sentences.zh: 再加上她拥有接触两名受害者的最多机会这一事实，最终巩固了他们的有罪裁决。

sentences.en: Victim impact statements were read at Stacey's sentencing hearing.
sentences.zh: 在斯泰西的量刑听证会上宣读了受害者影响陈述。

sentences.en: David Castor's son, David Junior, described his father as someone who worked hard and played hard and who loved life and still had so much ahead of him.
sentences.zh: 大卫·卡斯特的儿子小大卫将他的父亲描述为一个工作努力、玩得痛快、热爱生活且未来还有无限可能的人。

sentences.en: He was traumatised by hearing how Antifreeze had slowly and painfully shut his father's body down.
sentences.zh: 听到防冻液如何缓慢而痛苦地摧毁他父亲的身体，他受到了极大的心理创伤。

sentences.en: Seeing photographs of him naked in his own vomit, knowing the pain he endured, was devastating.
sentences.zh: 看到他赤身裸体躺在自己呕吐物中的照片，深知他所承受的痛苦，这令人心碎。

sentences.en: But having to listen to Stacey deny and slander him after his death was even worse.
sentences.zh: 但不得不听着斯泰西在他死后进行否认和诋毁，则更加糟糕。

sentences.en: The allegations that his father was a pedophile were particularly egregious.
sentences.zh: 关于他的父亲是恋童癖的指控尤其令人发指。

sentences.en: Let me set one thing straight, David Junior said.
sentences.zh: 小大卫说，让我澄清一件事。

sentences.en: My father was a good man, with a moral compass that pointed north.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲是一个好人，有着正确的道德罗盘。

sentences.en: He said his father's murder had caused a chain reaction of pain to everyone's life that he touched,
sentences.zh: 他说他父亲的谋杀给每一个与他接触过的人的生活都带来了痛苦的连锁反应，

sentences.en: and described Stacey as standing at the top of a ladder in which each rung represents a growing level of evil.
sentences.zh: 并将斯泰西形容为站在梯子顶端的人，梯子的每一级都代表着不断升级的邪恶。

sentences.en: He also expressed sympathy for the ordeal Stacey had put Ashley and Brie through, while praising the strength the sisters had shown throughout the trial.
sentences.zh: 他还对斯泰西给阿什利和布里带来的磨难表达了同情，同时赞扬了姐妹俩在整个庭审期间表现出的坚强。

sentences.en: With Brie by her side, Ashley said she was still burdened by the question of why her mother had done what she did, but accepted that she might never get an answer.
sentences.zh: 在布里的陪伴下，阿什利表示她仍然被这样一个问题困扰：为什么她的母亲要做出那样的事，但她接受了自己可能永远无法得到答案的事实。

sentences.en: She detailed the lives her mother had ruined, not only Michael and David's, but also those of their loved ones, as well as her own and her sisters.
sentences.zh: 她详细数落了母亲毁掉的生命，不仅是迈克尔和大卫的，还有他们所爱之人的，以及她和妹妹们的。

sentences.en: She spoke of how Stacey had forced family and friends to pick sides, and described her anxiety about whether the jury would believe her.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了斯泰西如何迫使家人和朋友选边站队，并描述了她对陪审团是否会相信她的焦虑。

sentences.en: Ashley continued to feel conflicted about her mother, admitting she both loved and hated her.
sentences.zh: 阿什利对母亲的感情依然充满矛盾，她承认自己既爱她又恨她。

sentences.en: That bothers me, she said.
sentences.zh: 这让我很苦恼，她说。

sentences.en: It's so confusing.
sentences.zh: 这太令人困惑了。

sentences.en: I never knew what hate was until now.
sentences.zh: 直到现在我才真正知道什么是恨。

sentences.en: More than anything, Ashley said she wanted her mother to apologise for everything, including the lies.
sentences.zh: 阿什利表示，比起什么都重要，她希望母亲为所有事情道歉，包括那些谎言。

sentences.en: Accepting that it was unlikely ever to come, Ashley promised not to shed any more tears over it.
sentences.zh: 既然接受了这种道歉几乎不可能到来，阿什利承诺不会再为此流一滴眼泪。

sentences.en: As horrible as it makes me feel, she concluded.
sentences.zh: 尽管这让我感觉很糟糕，她最后总结道。

sentences.en: This is goodbye, Mum.
sentences.zh: 再见，妈妈。

sentences.en: As hard as you tried, I survived, and I will survive, because now I am surrounded by people who love me.
sentences.zh: 尽管你百般尝试，我还是活了下来，而且我会继续活下去，因为现在我身边环绕着爱我的人。

sentences.en: The district attorney urged the judge to impose the maximum sentence on Stacey.
sentences.zh: 地区检察官敦促法官对斯泰西判处最高刑罚。

sentences.en: She highlighted Stacey's callous conduct, including how she continued to socialise in her backyard with
sentences.zh: 她强调了斯泰西冷血的行径，包括当女儿躺在床上为克服她给的过量药物而挣扎时，

sentences.en: friends as her daughter lay in bed fighting for her life from the overdose she had given her.
sentences.zh: 她却依然在后院和朋友们社交。

sentences.en: She is cold, calculating, and without any human emotion for what she has done, the DA said.
sentences.zh: 地方检察官说，她冷酷、算计，对自己所做的事没有任何人类的情感。

sentences.en: Human life is sacred.
sentences.zh: 人类的生命是神圣的。

sentences.en: Stacey Castor places no value on human life, not even her own flesh and blood.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·卡斯特对人命毫无价值感，甚至对她自己的亲生骨肉也一样。

sentences.en: To Stacey Castor, human beings are disposable.
sentences.zh: 对斯泰西·卡斯特来说，人类是可以随意抛弃的。

sentences.en: The judge, who admitted to seeing all types of killers during his three-decade career, called Stacey a firSt.
sentences.zh: 这位法官在三十年的职业生涯中见过各种各样的杀手，他称斯泰西是个史无前例的特例。

sentences.en: He had never seen a mother who was willing to sacrifice her own child's life in order to direct suspicion away from herself.
sentences.zh: 他从未见过一个母亲为了转移对自己的怀疑，宁愿牺牲自己亲生孩子的生命。

sentences.en: Remarking,
sentences.zh: 他评说道：

sentences.en: I have to say, Mrs Castor, that you are in a class all by yourself.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，卡斯特太太，你真是独树一帜、别具一格。

sentences.en: Unlike many defendants who pass through my courtroom, you're not just a danger to the general public, you're a danger to the people who love you and are closest to you.
sentences.zh: 与许多从我法庭走过的被告不同，你不仅对广大公众是个危险，对那些爱你、与你最亲近的人来说也是个危险。

sentences.en: I believe that the sentence that I'm about to impose others will remove that danger once and for all.
sentences.zh: 我相信我即将做出的判决将一劳永逸地消除这种危险。

sentences.en: Stacey Castor was sentenced to 25 years to life for the attempted murder of Ashley Wallace.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·卡斯特因企图谋杀阿什利·华莱士被判处 25 年至终身监禁。

sentences.en: She was given the same sentence for the murder of David
sentences.zh: 她因谋杀大卫·

sentences.en: Castor.
sentences.zh: 卡斯特被判处同样的刑期。

sentences.en: She would have to serve over 51 years behind bars before being eligible for parole, with her earliest possible release date being June 2055, a month shy of her 88th birthday.
sentences.zh: 她必须在铁窗后服刑超过 51 年才有资格获得假释，她最早可能的获释日期是 2055 年 6 月，当时距离她 88 岁生日仅差一个月。

sentences.en: In 2009, Stacey Castor agreed to be interviewed for a two-hour special for ABC's award-winning TV program 2020.
sentences.zh: 2009 年，斯泰西·卡斯特同意接受采访，参加美国广播公司（ABC）屡获殊荣的电视节目《20/20》的两个小时特辑。

sentences.en: In it, she continued to profess her innocence and accuse Ashley of knowing what really happened.
sentences.zh: 在节目中，她继续坚称自己无辜，并指责阿什利知道真正发生了什么。

sentences.en: A forensic psychiatrist told 2020 that offenders like Stacey tend to deny, deny, deny, until the bitter end, and that she would likely never admit guilt.
sentences.zh: 一位法医精神病学家告诉《20/20》，像斯泰西这样的罪犯往往会死不认账、抵赖到底，直到最后，而且她可能永远不会承认有罪。

sentences.en: Stacey chose not to be evaluated by a psychiatrist for the purpose of her trial, which would have opened the door to a potential mental health defence.
sentences.zh: 斯泰西选择不接受为了庭审目的而进行的精神病学评估，否则那本会为潜在的精神健康辩护打开大门。

sentences.en: As such, she hasn't been officially diagnosed with anything that might shed light on why an otherwise seemingly normal functioning wife and mother would not
sentences.zh: 因此，她并未被官方诊断出任何可能解释以下谜团的病症：为什么一个平时看起来功能正常的妻子和母亲，

sentences.en: only kill two husbands she professed to love dearly, but also attempt to implicate the daughter she claimed to be her best friend.
sentences.zh: 不仅会杀死她声称深爱的两个丈夫，还会试图陷害她口中的好朋友兼女儿。

sentences.en: The closest suggested motive is financial, but in Michael's case, he was not a wealthy man.
sentences.zh: 最接近的暗示动机是金钱，但在迈克尔的案件中，他并非一个富有的人。

sentences.en: David did have a successful business, though he still faced financial difficulties and his
sentences.zh: 大卫确实有一家成功的事业，尽管他仍面临财务困难，且他

sentences.en: $50,000 life insurance payout was not considered exorbitant.
sentences.zh: 5 万美元的人寿保险赔偿金并不算过分高昂。

sentences.en: Stacey Castor was never found legally responsible for the death of her first husband, but investigators remained convinced she was
sentences.zh: 斯泰西·卡斯特从未被法律认定对她第一任丈夫的死负有责任，但调查人员始终确信她难辞

sentences.en: responsible and ultimately closed the case on that basis.
sentences.zh: 其咎，并最终以此为基础结了案。

sentences.en: They considered it fortunate that Michael's remains weren't cremated, as the truth surrounding his death might otherwise never have been uncovered.
sentences.zh: 他们认为幸运的是迈克尔的遗体没有被火化，否则围绕他死因的真相可能永远不会被揭开。

sentences.en: They also acknowledged that, had Stacey not made the mistake of attempting a second poisoning, she may well have escaped justice for Michael's death entirely.
sentences.zh: 他们还承认，如果不是斯泰西犯下了企图实施第二次投毒的错误，她很有可能完全逃脱对迈克尔之死的法律制裁。

sentences.en: While there has been no evidence to suggest that Stacey has any other victims, it is widely accepted that she could have killed again had she not been found out.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有证据表明斯泰西还有其他受害者，但人们普遍认为，如果不是被发觉，她本可能会再次行凶。

sentences.en: However, she didn't display the broader traits typically associated with serial killers.
sentences.zh: 然而，她并未表现出通常与连环杀手相关的更广泛特征。

sentences.en: According to commentators, the one pattern she did demonstrate was an ability to use her own child in a way that served her own needs.
sentences.zh: 据评论员称，她确实表现出的唯一模式是能够以服务于自身需求的方式利用自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Neither Ashley nor Bree spoke to their mother again after the trial.
sentences.zh: 庭审结束后，阿什利和布里再也没有和她们的母亲说过话。

sentences.en: At 6.48am on Saturday June 11, 2016, seven and a half years into her prison sentence,
sentences.zh: 2016 年 6 月 11 日星期六上午 6 点 48 分，在服刑七年半后，

sentences.en: 48-year-old Stacey Castor was found dead in her prison cell.
sentences.zh: 48 岁的斯泰西·卡斯特被发现死在她的牢房里。

sentences.en: Her cause of death was a heart attack, and no foul play was suspected.
sentences.zh: 她的死因是心脏病发作，且没有谋杀嫌疑。

sentences.en: Stacey was laid to rest in a shared grave with her first husband,
sentences.zh: 斯泰西与她的第一任丈夫合葬在同一个墓穴中，

sentences.en: Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔。

sentences.en: Her burial placed each of her husband's, both her victims, on either side of her.
sentences.zh: 她的葬礼将她两任丈夫——也即她的两位受害者——分别安葬在她的两侧。

sentences.en: That same year, David's son arranged for his father's remains to be disinterred and re-buried elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 同年，大卫的儿子安排将他父亲的遗骨掘出，并重新安葬在别处。
